verses.text: Ephraim mualtung gama Ramathaim panin Zaph mi pasal khat om a, ama min pen Elkanah hi-in Yeroham tapa hi a, Yeroham pen Elihu’ tapa, Elihu pen Tohu’ tapa, Tohu pen Ephraim mi Zuph’ tapa ahi hi.
Amah in zi nih a nei hi: khat’ min pen Hannah hi a, adang khat’ min pen Peninnah ahi hi. Peninnah in ta nei-in ahih hangin Hannah in ta a nei kei hi.

Hih mipa pen Shiloh-a Vanglianpen Yahweh kiangah biakpiakna a pia ding leh a bia dingin a khuapi panin kum khat khit kum khat a paito zel hi. Eli’ tapa nihte pen Hophni leh Phinehas hi a, tua lai-ah Yahweh’ siampite ahi uh hi.
Elkanah in biakpiakna a piak ding ni a tun simin, a zi Peninnah leh a tanute a tapate khempeuh tungah sa sehtanhte a pia den hi.
Ahih hangin amah in Hannah it ahih manin Yahweh in a naubu a khaksak hangin amah in Hannah tungah sehtanh a zah nih a pia hi.
A naubu kikhaksakin a lungkham ahih manin langpangnu (Hillel, Lucifer, Satan) in zong amah nasia takin thangpaaisak hi.
Kum khat khit kum khat hi bangin ahi zel hi. Yahweh’ Inn ah amah a paitoh ciangin, tuanu (Hillel, Lucifer, Satan) in amah thangpaaisak, kapsakin tua ciangin an a ne kei hi.

Tua ciangin a pasal Elkanah in ama kiangah, “Hannah aw, bang hangin kap na hi hiam? Bang hangin an ne lo na hi hiam? Bang hangin lungkia na hi hiam? Nang aa dingin tapa sawm sangin hoihzaw hilo ka hi hiam?” a ci hi.
Khatvei, Shiloh ah amaute nekna leh dawnna a mankhit uh ciangin Hannah a dingto hi. Tu-in Yahweh’ biakbuk kongkhak-mung gei-a tutphah tungah siampi Eli a tu hi.
Tua hun lianin tuanu kha gimlua-in a kap ziahziah hi. Amah in Yahweh kiangah thungenin,

kiciamna khat bawl a, “Vanglianpen Yahweh aw, na nasemnu’ gimna hong en takpi-in na phawk a, na nasemnu nong mangngilh loin na nasemnu tapa khat nong piak leh, ama nuntak sung tawntung Yahweh tungah kong pia ding a, a lu tungah mulkiatna kitah lo ding hi,” a ci hi.
Tuanu in Yahweh tungah a thunget laitakin, Eli in a kam na encik hi.
Hannah in a lungsim tawh thungenin a mukte a tangtang a, ahih hangin a aw kizakhia lo hi. Tua ahih manin Eli in amah zukham a sa hi.
Tua ahih ciangin Eli in ama kiangah, “Bang tanvei zukhamin omlai ding na hi hiam? Na kiang panin leenggahzu hemkhia in!” a ci hi.

Ahih hangin Hannah in dawngin, “Hilo hi, ka ukpa aw, kei pen a lunggim mahmah numei khat ka hi hi. Leenggahzu ahi a, zukhauh ahi zongin ka dawn kei hi; ahi zongin Yahweh mai-ah ka kha a buakhia ka hi hi.
Lunggimlua singimlua-in thu ka ngetngetna hangin na nasemnu pen Belial’ tanu hong sa kei in,” a ci hi.
Tua ciangin Eli in dawngin, “Lungnuam takin pai in. Israyl’ Pa, Yahweh in Ama tunga na ngetsa thu hong pia tahen!” a ci hi.
Tua ciangin amah in, “Na muhna ah na nasemnu maipha hong musak in,” a ci hi. Tua ciangin tuanu pai-in bang khatpeuh ne-in, dahmai a pua nawn kei hi.
A zingciang zingsangin amaute thobaih-in Yahweh mai panin bia uh a, tua khit ciangin Ramah-a a inn ah a ciah uh hi. Elkanah in a zi Hannah luppihin, Yahweh in tuanu a phawk hi.

Tua ahih manin Hannah a gaikhit ciangin, Yahweh’ kum siangtho; tekufah, hun sungin amah in tapa khat nei-in a min Samuyl a phuak hi; amah in, “bang hang hiam cihleh Yahweh’ kiangah amah ka ngen hi,” a ci hi.
Kum sim biakpiakna Yahweh tungah a pia dingin a innkuan khempeuh tawh Elkanah a paitoh ciangin, amah kiciam a,

amah tawh Hannah paito lo hi; bang hang hiam cihleh amah in a pasal kiangah, “Naupang nawi tawh a kikhen ciangin, Yahweh mai-ah amah a pia dingin ka paipih ding a, tua lai-ah amah tengsuak ding hi,” a ci hi.

Tua ciangin a pasal Elkanah in ama kiangah, “Hoihpen nasak bangin hih inla nawi tawh a kikhen mateng ngak in. Na kammal pen Yahweh tawh kipsak hamtang in,” a ci hi.Tua ahih manin nupinu inn ah omin a tapa nawi tawh a kikhen dong a kem hi.
Numei in nawi tawh amah a khen ciangin, kum thum a pha bawngtal khat, annel ephah khat, leh leenggahzu savun thawl khat tawh amah la-in, Shiloh-a Yahweh’ Inn ah a paipih hi. Naupang pen a neu lai hi.
Tua ciangin amaute in bawngtal go-in, Eli kiangah naupang paipih uh a,
Tuanu in, “Ka ukpa aw, nangmah a nungta na hih mah bangin, kei pen Yahweh tunga thungenin nangma gei hih lai-a a ding numeipen ka hi hi.
Hih naupang aa dingin thu ka ngen a, Yahweh in Ama kiangah ka ngetna hong piakhin hi.
Tua ahih manin tu-in Yahweh kiangah amah a pia ding ka hi ta hi. Ama nuntak lai teng Yahweh tungah kipia ding hi,” a ci hi. Tua ciangin amaute in tua lai-ah Yahweh a bia uh hi.
Tua ciangin Hannah in thungenin, “Yahweh sungah ka lungsim in nuamsa hi; Yahweh sungah ka thahatna kisangsak hi. Yahweh’ hotkhiatna ah nuamsa ka hih manin ka galte ka nuihsan hi.
Yahweh bangin a siangtho khat zong omlo hi; Nang simloh kuamah dang om lo hi; i Pa tawh a kibang Suangpi, kuamah om lo hi.
Kiphatsak paupau kei inla, tua bang kihihsakna na kam panin gingsak kei in; bang hang hiam cihleh Yahweh pen a thei gige Pa hi a, Amah in gamtatnate a tawi khai hi.
Galkapte’ thalte kitankhin a, ahih hangin a muktute thahatna tawh a umcih hi.
A gilvahte in an thalawh uh a, ahih hangin a gilkialte a kial nawn kei hi. Tasel nu in ta sagih neikhin a, ahih hangin tapa tampi a nei nu pen zawngkhal ta hi.
Yahweh in thatin, zong hingsak hi; Amah in gankhuk ah paipihsukin, thosak hi.
Yahweh in a zawng bawlin, a hau zong a bawl hi; Amah in niamkhiatin, zong a lamto hi.

Kumpi-tapate lakah a tu dingin leivui panin a zawngte phongto a, khutdawh ngente vutphual panin domto-in minthanna kumpi-tokhom a luahsak hi. Bang hang hiam cihleh leitung bulpite Yahweh aa hi a, tuate tungah Amah in leitung a nga hi.
Amah in a misiangte cing ding a, ahih hangin migilote ahih leh khuamial sungah daitakin om ding uh hi. Bang hang hiam cihleh tua pen mite’ thahatna tawh hih zawh ding hi lo hi.

Yahweh a langpante tamkham ding uh hi. Amah in vantung panin amaute tungah kek kiasak ding hi; Yahweh in leimongte dong ah thukhen ding hi; Amah in a Kumpipa tungah thahatna pia ding a, Ama sathau nilhpa’ ki sangsak ding hi,” a ci hi.
Tua khit ciangin Elkanah zong Ramah-a ama inn ah a ciahkik hi; ahih hangin naupang in siampi Eli khutnuai, Yahweh kiangah biaknasep a sem hi.
Tu-in Eli’ tapate pen Belial’ tapate hi a, amaute in Yahweh thei lo uh hi.
Hih pen mi khatpeuh in biakna a piak ciangin siampipa in mite tawh a hihzia ding hi a, sa a kihuan laitakin siampipa’ nasempa in a khut ah sikkeu-ka-thum nei tawi-in a pai ding hi.

Tua khit ciangin amah in sikbeel-dai ahi a, beel-uk ahi a, beelpi ahi a, beel sungah ahi zongin tua sikkeu-ka sunsuk ding a, sikkeu-ka in a laktoh khak peuhpeuh siampipa in ama aa dingin la ding hi. Hih pen Shiloh ah a paito Israyl-te khempeuh tungah amaute in a hih dan uh ahi hi.

Ahih hangin a thaute a kihal ma nangawnin siampipa’ nasempa pai-in, biakna a pia mipa kiangah, “Hankeu ding sa pawlkhat siampipa pia in; amah in a kihuansa hong sang lo ding a, a sial bek hong sang ding hi,” a ci hi.

Tua ciangin mipa in ama kiangah, “A thaute kihaltum masa henla, tua khit ciangin na deihna peuhpeuh la in,” a cih leh, nasempa in, “Hilo hi, tu mahmahin hong pia in; nong piak pah kei leh, thatang suangin kong sut ding hi,” ci-in a dawng hi.
Tua ahih manin Yahweh mai-ah tangvalpa mawhna lian mahmah hi, bang hang hiam cihleh mite in simmawh bawlna tawh Yahweh’ biakna pia a suak uh hi.
Ahih hangin Samuyl in Yahweh mai-ah biaknasep sem a—naupang in saihadial siampipuan khat a silh hi.
A nu in ama aa dingin puantual neu khat bawlsakin, kum khat khit kum khat a pasal tawh kum sim biakpiakna pia dingin a paitoh ciangin Samuyl kiangah a puak hi.

Tua ciangin Eli in Elkanah leh a zi thupha pia-in, “Yahweh tungah a kipia letsong mun ah mun a la dingin Yahweh in hih numei tung panin suanlekhakte hong pia tahen,” a ci hi. Tua ciangin a inn ah amaute a ciah uh hi.
Tua ciangin Yahweh in Hannah hehpih a, tuanu gai-in tapa thum leh tanu nih a nei hi. Tua hun sungin naupang Samuyl Yahweh’ Omna ah a khang hi.
Tu-in a tek mahmah ta Eli in, Israyl khempeuh tunga a tapate bawlna thu khempeuh leh Kikhopna Puanbuk lutna-a na a sem numeite tawh a lupkhopna thute a za hi.
Tua ahih manin amah in amaute kiangah, “Tua bangin bang hangin gamta na hi uh hiam? Na gamtatsiatnate uh mi khempeuh kiang panin ka za hi.
Hilo hi, ka tapate aw! Bang hang hiam cihleh thukipuak ka zakte thutang hilo a, note in Yahweh’ mite na khialsak uh hi.

Mi khat in adang khat tungah a mawh leh, Yahweh in ama thu khen ding hi. Ahih hangin mi khat in Yahweh tungah a mawh leh, ama aa dingin kua in thuumsak ding ahi hiam?” a ci hi. Ahih hangin a tapate in a pa’ taina ngai lo uh hi, bang hang hiam cihleh hih pen amaute a thahna dingin Yahweh’ deihna ahi hi.
Tua ciangin naupang Samuyl a pumpi khangin Yahweh leh mite maipha a ngah hi.

Tu-in Eli kiangah Yahweh’ mi khat pai-in ama kiangah, “Yahweh thugen hi bang ahi hi: Egypt gam sung Pharaoh khutnuai ah na pate a om lai-in na pa’ innkuan tungah Kei mahmah kician takin kilaak hilo ka hi hiam?

Ka siampi a hi ding, Ka biaknatau tungah biakna a pia ding, paknamtui a hal ding, leh Keima mai-ah siampipuan a silh dingin Israyl minamte khempeuh panin amah teelkhia hilo ka hi hiam? Mei tawh kihal Israyl mite biaknate khempeuh na pa’ innkuan tungah pia hilo ka hi hiam?

Ka biakpiakna leh Ka tenna mun aa dingin ka sehsa Ka biakna bang hangin neu-etin zahpih na hi uh hiam? Bang hangin ka mi Israyl-te hong piaksa biakna limcipente tawh no le no kivakthau-in kei sangin na tapate uh pahtawizaw na hi uh hiam?” a ci hi.

Tua ahih ciangin Israyl’ Pa, Yahweh in, “Nangma innkuan leh na pa’ innkuan in a tawntungin Keima mai-ah biaknasep sem ding hi, ci-in kiciam hi. Ahih hangin tu-in Yahweh in, ‘Tua bang hi peuhmah lo ding hi! Kei hong pahtawite ka pahtawi ding a, kei hong simmawhte ka simmawh ding hi.
En in, a hun hong tungta ding a, nangma thahatna leh na pa’ innkuan thahatna ka khiap ciangin, na innkuan gui sungah puteek om nawn lo ding hi.
Ka tenna mun ah lunggimna na mu ding hi. Israyl-te tungah thuman takin na gamtat hangin na innkuan gui sungah puteek cikmahin om nawn lo ding hi.

Ka biaknatau panin ka khenkhiat loh note khatpeuh, na mittangte khitui tawh a mialcip nading leh na lungsim a khasiat nading bekin hong kihawi lai ding a, na innkuan sung suanlekhakte khempeuh khansih ding uh hi.
Na tapa tegel ahi Hophni leh Phinehas tungah a piang peuhmah pen nang aa dingin etsakna lim hi ding hi: ni khat sungin a nituakun si ding uh hi.

Tua khit ciangin Keimah in Ka lungtang sung leh ka lungsim sunga om peuhpeuh tawh kizui-in a sem ding a citak ciampi khat Kei aa dingin ka khangsak ding hi. Keimah in ama inn kiptakin ka phut ding a, amah in ka sathau nilhpa mai-ah biaknasep sem tawntung ding hi.

Nguntang khat leh anlum nengkhat hangin na innkuan gui-a a om laite peuhpeuh pai-in ama mai-ah kun ding uh a, ‘Nek ding an pawlkhat na ngah theih nadingin siampi zum mun khat ah kei hong semsak in,’ ci-in hong thuum ding hi,’ ci hi,” a ci hi.
Eli khutnuai Yahweh kiangah naupang Samuyl in biaknasep a sem hi. Tua hun lai-in Yahweh’ kammal kitamzak loin maangmuhna zong tampi omlo hi.
Khua a mu nawn lo dek zah dongin a mitte a mang lua ta Eli pen zan khat ama omna mun ah a lup ciangin,
Yahweh’ meivak tum nai lo a, Samuyl pen Yahweh’ singkuang a omna Yahweh’ biakbuk sungah a lum hi.
Tua khit ciangin Yahweh in Samuyl samin, amah in, “Hiah om ing ei,” ci-in a dawng hi.
Tua ciangin Eli kiangah amah tai-in, “Hong sam na hia, hiah om ing ei,” a ci hi. Tua ciangin Eli in, “Hong sam keng ei. Pai inla lumkik o,” a ci hi. Tua ciangin amah pai-in a lum hi.

Yahweh in, “Samuyl,” ci-in sam leuleu hi. Tua ahih manin Samuyl thoto-in Eli kiangah pai-in, “Hong sam na hia, hiah om ing ei,” a ci hi. Ahih hangin Eli in, “Hong sam keng ei, ka tapa aw, paikik inla lum o,” a ci hi.
(Tu-in Samuyl in Yahweh ahih lam phawkkha nai lo a, Yahweh’ kammal Samuyl tungah a kilaak lam zong a phawkkha kei hi.)
Tua ciangin Yahweh in Samuyl a thumveina sam leuleu a, Samuyl thoto-in Eli kiangah pai-in, “Hong sam na hia, hiah om ing ei,” a ci hi. Tua ciangin Yahweh in naupang a sap lam Eli in a phawk hi.
Tua ahih manin Eli in Samuyl kiangah, “Pai inla lum in. Amah in nang hong sap leh, ‘Yahweh aw, hong gen in, Na nasempa in ka za hi,’ ci in,” a ci hi. Tua ciangin Samuyl pai-in ama mun ah a lum hi.
Tua khit ciangin Yahweh hong pai-in tua lai-ah hong ding a, a masa-a mah bangin “Samuyl! Samuyl!” ci-in a sam hi. Tua ciangin Samuyl in, “Hong gen in, Na nasempa in ka za hi,” a ci hi.
Tua ciangin Yahweh in Samuyl kiangah, “Ngai in, Israyl sungah na khat a sem ding ka hita a, tua thu in a za peuhmah bilte khawng ding hi.
Tua hun ciangin Eli innkuan tunga ka gensa khempeuh a patna pan a tawpna dong Eli tungah ka tungsak ding hi.
Bang hang hiam cihleh amah in a theisa tatsiatna hangin ama inn a tawntungin thu ka khen ding lam amah ka genkhin hi. A tapate in Yahweh simmawh bawl uh a, amah in amaute khaam lo hi.
Tua ahih ciangin Eli’ innkuante mawhna pen biakpiakna ahih keileh biakna in a maisak zawh ngei loh nadingin Eli’ innkuan tungah ka kiciamkhin hi,” a ci hi.
Tua ciangin zingsang dong Samuyl lum a, tua khit ciangin Yahweh’ Inn kongkhakte a hong hi, ahih hangin amah in tua maangmuhna Eli tungah a gen ding lau hi.
Tua ciangin Eli in Samuyl samsakin, “Ka tapa, Samuyl aw!” a ci hi. Tua ciangin amah in, “Hiah om ing ei,” a ci hi.

Tua khit ciangin amah in, “Amah in nang tungah bang hong gen ahi hiam? Kei tungah hong im kei in. Amah in nang hong gen peuhpeuh kei tungah nong ip leh, Yahweh in a ut bangin hong bawl henla, zong hong behlap lai tahen,” a ci hi.
Tua tak ciangin Samuyl in a vekpi in a gen hi. Amah in Eli tungah bangmah imlo hi. Tua ahih manin Eli in, “Amah pen Yahweh hi. Ama mitte ah man a sak bangin hih hen!” a ci hi.
Tua ciangin Samuyl hong khangkhang a, Yahweh in amah ompihin a tangko khiat ama kammalte a tangtunglo khat beek om lo hi.
Tua ciangin Dan panin Beersheba dong ah Israyl khempeuh in Samuyl pen Yahweh’ kamsangin a kikipsakna a thei uh hi.
Tua ciangin Shiloh ah Yahweh kilang toto hi; Yahweh’ kammal tawh Shiloh-a Samuyl tungah Yahweh a kilaak hi.
Tua ciangin Samuyl’ kammal Israyl khempeuh ah a kizel hi.
Philistia-te in Israyl-te a maituah dingin panmun la uh a, kidona kizeizai-in Philistia-te in Israyl-te zo-in gallak ah Israyl mi 4,000 bang a that uh hi.

Giahphual ah mite a ciahkik uh ciangin Israyl upate in, “Tuni-in Yahweh in Philistia-te mai-ah bang hangin eite hong do ahi hiam? Shiloh panin hih lai mun eite kiangah Yahweh’ thuciamna singkuang paipih ni, tua hileh eite lakah tua hong tun ciangin i galte kiang panin hong hon theikha ding hi,” a ci uh hi.

Tua ahih manin mipite in Shiloh ah mi sawl uh a, cherub-te kikala a tu Vanglianpen Yahweh, Yahweh’ thuciamna singkuang puasak uh hi. Tua ciangin Eli’ tapa tegel Hophni leh Phinehas zong Yahweh’ thuciamna singkuang tawh a om uh hi.
Giahphual ah Yahweh’ thuciamna singkuang a tun ciangin, Israyl khempeuh lei a ling zah dong dingin a awng uh hi.

Philistia-te in tua otna ging a zak uh ciangin, amaute in, “Hebrew-te giahphual sunga hih otna pen bang a cihnopna ahi hiam?” ci-in a dong uh hi. Amaute in giahphual ah Yahweh’ singkuang a tunkhit lam a theih uh ciangin,
Philistia-te a lau uh a, amaute in, “Giahphual ah pasian khat (el) tungkhin hi! Ei aa ding dahhuai hi; buaina sungah i om hi! Nidangin hih bang piang ngei nai lo hi.

Ei aa ding dahhuai hi; buaina sungah i om hi. Hih a vanglian pasiante (elohim) khut panin kua in ei hong hon ding ahi hiam? Hihte pen sehnel gam ah pulnatna nam khempeuh tawh Egypt mite a vatgawp pasiante hi!
Philistia mite aw thahat un! Kipasalsak un, tua hi kei leh amaute na nasem a suah bang teekteekun Hebrew-te nasem na suak ding uh hi. Pasal bangin hih unla, do un!” a ci uh hi.
Tua ciangin Philistia-te in Israyl-te simin zo uh a, miteng amau’ puanbuk tek ah a tai uh hi. Tua lai-ah nakpi takin kithahna om a, Israyl khe galkap 30,000 a puk hi.
Yahweh’ singkuang kiman a, Eli’ tapa nih tegel Hophni leh Phinehas-te zong a kithat hi.
Tua ni-in galkidona phual panin Benyamin mi khat tai-in a puante kikeksa leh a lu tungah leivui baangsa-in Shiloh ah hong tung hi.

Amah a tun ciangin Yahweh’ singkuang hangin Eli a lungsim lau ahih manin lampi gei, a tutphah tungah tu-in a khuadakdak hi. Khuapi ah mipa a lut ciangin amah in thu piang teng a gen ciangin, khua sung mi khempeuh a kiko uh hi.
Eli in patauhna awging a zak ciangin, amah in, “Hih gamlumna bang thu ahi hiam?” ci-in a dong hi. Tua ciangin mipa manlangin hong pai-in Eli kiang a gen hi.
Eli pen kum 98 pha a, a mitte mang mahmah ta-in a mu mialmial lai bek ahi hi.

Tua ciangin mipa in Eli kiangah, “Keimah, Galphual panin hong pai ka hi hi. Tuni-in galkidona phualpi panin hong tai ka hi hi,” a ci hi. Tua ciangin amah in, “Ka tapa aw, bang piang ahi hiam?” a ci hi.

Tua ciangin kamtaipa in dawng a, “Philistia-te mai panin Israyl-te tai a, i galkapte lakah nakpi takin kithahna a om hi. Na tapa tenih Hophni leh Phinehas si uh a, Philistia-te in Yahweh’ singkuang man uh hi,” a ci hi.

Amah in Yahweh’ singkuang a cih ciangin, kulhkongpi nawl-a a tutphah panin Eli thalpuk hi. A ngawng kitanin amah si hi; bang hang hiam cihleh amah pen putek khat hi a, a gik hi. Amah in Israyl-te kum 40 sung thukhen hi.

A monu Phinehas’ zi pen naupaai-in a suak ding hun a naita ahi hi. Tuanu in Yahweh’ singkuang a kimatna thu, leh a teekpa leh a pasal a sihna thu a zak ciangin, nausuah natna in tunin nau a suak hi. Ahih hangin tuanu thuak lah mahmahin,
amah si dektak a, amah a don numeite in, “Lungneu kei in tapa khat na neikhin hi,” a ci hi. Ahih hangin amah in dawngkik lo a, a tapa zong a awlmawh zo kei hi.
Yahweh’ singkuang a kimatna hang leh a teekpa leh a pasal hangin, “Israyl-te kiang panin minthanna kilakhiakhin hi,” a cih nopna-in tuanu in naupangpa min Ichabod; Minthanna Omlo, ci-in phuak hi.
Tua khit ciangin tuanu in, “Yahweh’ singkuang kimankhin ahih manin Israyl-te kiang panin minthanna kilakhiakhin hi,” a ci hi.
Tua ciangin Philistia-te in Yahweh’ singkuang la uh a, Ebenezer panin Ashdod ah a pua uh hi.
Philistia-te in Yahweh’ singkuang la-in amaute in a pasian uh Dagon biakinnpi sungah paipih uh a, Dagon gei lian ah a koih uh hi.

A zingciang zingsang tuungin Ashdod mite a thawh uh ciangin, Yahweh’ singkuang mai leilak ah Dagon milim maipukin na om hi. Tua ahih manin amaute in Dagon milim la-in a omna ngei mah ah a koih kik uh hi.

A zingciang zingsang tuungin a thawh uh ciangin Yahweh’ singkuang mai leilak ah Dagon milim maipukin na om a, ahih hangin hih hun ah a lu leh a khut tenih kitanin, sangkil tungah omin, a pumpi bek kisia loin a omlai hi.
Hih thu hangin Dagon siampite ahi a, Ashdod-a Dagon biakinnpi sunga a lut peuhpeuh in ahi zongin tuni dongin sangkil tung sik lo uh hi.
Yahweh’ khut in Ashdod mite leh a gam tungah nasia takin gawt hi; Amah in amaute bawlsia dikdekin, a khal kawm ah meimatum tawh a vatgawp hi.

Ashdod mite in amaute tunga thupiangte a muh uh ciangin, amaute in, “Israyl-te pasian’ singkuang ei tawh hong om peuhmah lo ding hi; bang hang hiam cihleh eite lam leh i Pasian Dagon tungah Ama khut khauh lua hi,” a ci uh hi.

Tua ahih manin amaute in Philistia gam-ukte khempeuh sam khawmin amaute in, “Israyl-te pasian singkuang bang cih ding i hi hiam?” ci-in a dong uh hi. Amaute in, “Gath ah Israyl-te pasian singkuang koih ni,” ci-in a dawng uh hi. Tua ahih manin amaute in Israyl’ Pa singkuang a khin uh hi.
Ahih hangin amaute in a khinkhit uh ciangin, Yahweh’ khut in tua khuapi suksiatna lianpi tawh hih a, Amah in khua sung mite, a moi a hamin a khal kawm ah meimatum tawh a vatgawp hi.

Tua ahih manin amaute in Ekron ah Yahweh’ singkuang puak uh hi. Ekron ah Yahweh’ singkuang a tun ciangin tua khua mite kiko-in, “Eite leh i mite hong that nadingin amaute in Israyl-te pasian singkuang hong paipih uh hi,” a ci uh hi.

Tua ahih ciangin amaute in Philistia gam-ukte khempeuh sam khawm uh a, “Israyl-te pasian’ singkuang puakhia un! Ama omna ngei ah paikiksak un, tua hi keileh tua in ko leh ka mite uh hong that ding hi!” a ci uh hi. Bang hang hiam cihleh khuapi sung khempeuh ah sidek liangin suksiatna om a, Yahweh’ khut pen tua lai-ah gik lua hi.
A si lo sunte in a khal kawm ah meimatum vei uh a, tua khuate kikona in van a ban hi.
Philistia-te gam sungah Yahweh’ singkuang kha sagih sung a om hi.
Tua ciangin Philistia-te in siampi khat leh aisante samin, “Yahweh’ singkuang bang cih ding ka hi uh hiam? A omna ngei ah bangci bangin puakkik ding ka hi uh hiam, hong gen un,” a ci uh hi.

Amaute in, “Israyl-te pasian (el) singkuang na puakkik uh leh, a hawm guakin puak kei unla, Ama tungah khialhna hanga biakna tawh na piakhawm hamtang ding hi. Tua ciangin note na dam ding uh a, note kiang panin a khut a hepkhiat lam na thei ding uh hi,” ci-in a dawng uh hi.

Tua ciangin amaute in, “Ama tungah ka piak ding uh khialhna hanga biakna pen bang ahi hiam?” a ci uh hi. Tua ciangin amaute in, “Note leh na upate tungah a kibangin gimna hong tung a hih manin Philistia-te upate a phazah tawh kizui-in kham meimatum nga leh kham zusa nga khak un.

Tua ahih manin na gam sung uh hong susia zusa limte leh meimatum limte na bawl ding uh a, Israyl-te pasian (el) tungah pahtawina-in na pia ding uh hi. Tua hileh note kiang pan, na Pasiante (Elohim) kiang pan leh na gam uh panin Amah in a khut lakhia thei kha ding hi.

Tua hi napi-in bang hangin Eygpt mite leh Pharaoh in a lungsim uh a khauhsak bangin na lungsim khauhsak na hi uh hiam? Amah in amaute khauhtakin a gawt ciangin Israyl-te pai nading ah amaute in Israyl-te sawlkhia uh hilo ahi hiam?
Tua ahih ciangin tu-in kol a kisuan ngei nai lo bawngpi nawisuk lai nih la-in leeng thak khat lakhol unla, bawngpite leeng ah vawh un, ahih hangin a note kaikhia-in mun khat ah khumcip un.

Yahweh’ singkuang la unla, leeng tungah koihin khialhna hanga na biakna-un a kiangah kham nate singkuang khat sungah koihin Ama tungah na pia ding uh hi. Tua khit ciangin a paina ding lam ah paisak unla,

ahih hangin encik gige un. Tua in ama gam lam manawhin Beth Shemesh lam ah a paitoh leh, hih siatna lianpi hong tungsakpa pen Amah ahi hi. Ahih hangin tua in tua lam manawhin a pai keileh, eite hong vatgawp pen Ama khut hilo hi, ci-in i thei ding hi; tua pen eite tungah hong tungin a piang mawkmawk hi lel ding hi,” ci-in a dawng uh hi.
Tua ciangin mite in tua bang lianin a hih uh hi. Amaute in bawngpi nawisuk lai nih la-in leeng ah vawh uh a, a note inn ah a khumcip uh hi.
Amaute in leeng tungah Yahweh’ singkuang koihin, kham zusate leh meimatum milimte a kiguanna singkuang zong a koih uh hi.

Tua khit ciangin bawngpite in Beth Shemesh lam manawhin tangtakin pai uh a, lam tawntungah a hamham uh hi. Amaute, veilam ahi a, taklam ahi zongin pial loin, Philistia gam-ukte in Beth Shemesh gamgi dong a nungzuih uh hi.
Tu-in Beth Shemesh mite in kuam sungah a mangbuh a lak laitak uh hi a, amaute khuadakin singkuang a muh uh ciangin, a muhna uh hangin a lungdam mahmah uh hi.

Beth Shemesh-a Yahshua lo ah leeng hong tungin, tua lai mun suangtum lianpi gei khat ah a khawl hi. Tua ciangin amaute in a leeng singte ekkham uh a, Yahweh tungah meihal biakna-in a bawngpite a pia uh hi.

Levi mite in Yahweh’ Singkuang leh kham nate a kiguanna singkuang lasuk uh a, tua suangtum lianpi tungah a koih uh hi. Tua khit ciangin Beth Shemesh mite in meihal biaknate pia-in tua ni mahin Yahweh tungah biakpiaknate a bawl uh hi.
Philistia gam-uk ngate in hihte khempeuh mu uh a, tua khit ciangin Ekron ah tua ni mahin a ciahkik uh hi.

Hihte pen Philistia mite in Yahweh tungah khialhna hanga biakna-in a piak uh kham meimatumte ahi hi: Ashdod aa ding khat, Gaza aa ding khat, Ashkelon aa ding khat, Gath aa ding khat, Ekron aa ding khat ahi hi.

Kham zusa pen Philistia gam-uk ngate’ khuapi khempeuh a phazah taang ding hi a—kulha ki-um khuapite leh a khuaneute tawh ahi hi. Abel, YAHWEH INN LIANPI, amaute in Yahweh’ singkuang a koihna mun pen tuni dongin Beth Shemesh-a Yahshua lo sungah teci ahi hi.

Ahih hangin Beth Shemesh mite in Yahweh’ singkuang sung en uh ahih manin Yahweh in amaute a vatgawp hi. Amaute in Yahweh’ singkuang sung enkhin uh ahih manin Amah in amaute mi 70 a sisak hi. Yahweh in amaute a nakthuaksak luatna hangin mite a tau uh hi.
Tua ciangin Beth Shemesh mite in, “Hih a Siangtho Pa Yahweh mai-ah kua ding zo ding ahi hiam? Hih mun panin kua kiangah paito ding ahi hiam?” ci-in a dong uh hi.
Tua ahih manin amaute in Kiryath Yearim-a tengte kiangah kamtaite sawlin, “Philistia mite in Yahweh’ singkuang hong puakkik uh hi. Hong paisuk unla ciahpih un,” a ci uh hi.
Tua ciangin Kiryath Yearim mite hong pai-in Yahweh’ singkuang la uh a, mualtung-a Abinadab inn sungah paipihin, Yahweh’ singkuang a kem dingin a tapa Eleazar a siansuah uh hi.
Tua ahih manin Kiryath Yearim ah sauveipi singkuang a om hi; tua lai-ah kum 20 omin, Israyl innkuan khempeuh Yahweh ngai-in a thuum uh hi.

Tua ciangin Samuyl in Israyl innkuan khempeuh kiangah a gen inah, “Yahweh kiangah na lungsim khempeuh uh tawh ciahkik uh leh, note laka pasiante (elohim) leh Ashtaroth; nusiante, hemkhia un. Na lungsimte uh kigingkholin Yahweh tungah ki-ap unla, Amah bek bia-in a na sem un. Tua ciangin Amah in Philistia mite khut panin note hong honkhia ding hi,” a ci hi.
Tua ahih manin Israyl mite in Baal-te; Topate leh Pasiante (Elohim), leh Ashtaroth; nusiante, Astarte leh Easter, paaikhia-in Yahweh bek bia-in a na a sem uh hi.
Tua ciangin Samuyl in, “Mizpah ah Israyl mi khempeuh khawm unla, keimah in note tangin Yahweh tungah thu ka ngen ding hi,” a ci hi.

Tua ahih ciangin Mizpah ah amaute kikaikhawm uh hi. Amaute in tui tawi-in Yahweh mai-ah sungkhia uh hi. Tua ni-in amaute in an tang uh a, tua lai-ah kipulaakin, “Yahweh tungah i mawhkhin hi,” a ci uh hi. Tua ciangin Samuyl in Mizpah ah Israyl-te thu a khen hi.

Mizpah ah Israyl mite a kikaihkhopna thu Philistia-te in a zak uh ciangin, amaute a do dingin Philistia gam-ukte a kuanto uh hi. Hih thu Israyl mite in a zak uh ciangin, Philistia-te hangin amaute a kihta uh hi.
Amaute in Samuyl kiangah, “Yahweh in Philistia-te khut panin eite hong hot nadingin kote tangin Yahweh tungah kikona khawl kei in,” a ci uh hi.
Samuyl in nawi ne lai tuuno khat la-in, Yahweh tungah a buppi-a meihal biakna-in a pia hi. Tua khit ciangin Yahweh tungah Israyl-te tangin Samuyl kikokhia-in Yahweh in amah dawng hi.

Samuyl in meihal biakna a piak laitakin Israyl-te a sim dingin Philistia-te hong nai ta uh hi. Ahih hangin Yahweh in tua ni-in Philistia-te tungah vanging ngaih mahmah gingsakin amaute patausak gawp a, Israyl-te mai panin amaute a kizogawp uh hi.
Mizpah panin Israyl mite kituh liangin paikhia-in Philistia-te nungdelh uh a, Beth Car nuai munsan ciang dongah amaute a satlum uh hi.
Tua ciangin Samuyl in suangtum khat la-in Mizpah leh Shen kikal ah a phut hi. Amah in a min Ebenezer; Huhna Suangtum, ci-in phuakin, “Tu ciang dong Yahweh in eite hong huhkhin hi,” a ci hi.
Hih bangin Philistia-te guallel uh a, Israyl gam a va sim ngam nawn kei uh hi. Samuyl a nuntak sungteng Yahweh’ khut in Philistia-te a langpan hi.

Philistia-te in a matsa khuapite Ekron panin Gath ciang Israyl-te in ngahkik uh a, Israyl-te in Philistia-te vangliatna panin a gam uh lakik hi. Israyl leh nitumna lama tengte kikal ah zong kilemna a om hi.
Samuyl in a nuntak sung tawntungin Israyl-te thu a khen hi.
Beth-El, Gilgal leh Mizpah, Israyl gam sunga tua munte khempeuh ah thukhenin kum khat khit kum khat kot paipai hi.
Ahih hangin a inn omna Ramah ah ciahkik den hi. Tua lai-ah zong amah in Israyl-te thu khenin, Yahweh tungah biaknatau khat lam hi.
Samuyl a teek ciangin, amah in Israyl-te thukhenin a tapate a koih hi.
A tapa masa’ min pen Yahyl hi a, a nihnapa pen Abiyah ahi hi. Amaute in Beersheba ah thukhen uh a,
ahih hangin a tapate in ama lampite zui lo uh hi. Amaute in thuman lo-a ngahna ding kin-in, sumgolh la-in, thutang a heikhia uh hi.
Tua ciangin Israyl upate khempeuh kikaikhawmin, Ramah ah Samuyl a om lai-in ama hong neh uh a,
ama kiangah, “Nang na teek ta a, na tapate in na lampite zuilo uh hi. Minam dangte khempeuh bangin kote thu hong khen dingin kumpi khat hong sehsak in,” a ci uh hi.
Ahih hangin amaute in a diakdiakin, “Kote thu hong khen dingin kumpi khat hong pia in,” a cih uh ciangin, hih thute in Samuyl lungnuamsak hetlo hi. Tua ciangin Samuyl in Yahweh tungah thu a ngen hi.

Yahweh in Samuyl dawngin, “Mite in nang tunga hong gen thute khempeuh ngai in; bang hang hiam cihleh amaute in nang hong nial lo uh a, Keimah in amaute ka uk loh nadingin amaute in Kei hong nial uh ahi hi.
Egypt panin amaute ka paikhiatpih ni panin Kei tunga hong gamtat bang teekteekun tuni dongin nangma tunga amaute hong gamtata uh a—Pasian(te); Elohim!, na a sep theih nadingun Kei hong taisan uh hi.
Tua ahih manin amaute’ thu ngai in. Ahi zongin limtakin vauhilh inla, amaute tungah a uk ding kumpipa in amaute a bawlzia ding theisak bek in,” a ci hi.
Samuyl in ama tunga kumpi khat a ngen mite tungah Yahweh’ kammalte khempeuh a gen hi.

Samuyl in, “Hih pen note tungah hong uk dinga na lunggulh uh kumpipa gamtatzia ding ahi hi: Amah in na tapate la-in a leengte tawh na sem dingin amaute pawlkhat sehin—pawlkhat in a leeng-a sakolte hawl ding uh a, adangte a leengte mai-ah tai ding uh hi.

Amah in a galkapte aa dingin a ukte seh ding a—a tultulte a uk ding, a zazate a uk ding seh ding hi. Na tapate in a lo khawhsak ding uh a, adangte in a anlaksak ding uh a, a omlaite in galvanzatte leh a leengte aa ding nazatte a bawlsak ding uh hi.
Amah in na tanute uh la-in a gimnamtui bawlte, a an huante leh a moh emte-in a seh ding hi.
Amah in na lote, na leenggah lote leh na olive kungte uh panin a hoihpente hong matsakin, a uliante kiangah pia ding hi.
Amah in na an uh leh na leenggah kaihkhopsate panin sawm-ah-khat hong kai-in, a uliante leh amah a cingte pia ding hi.
Amah in na nasem pasalte, na nasem numeite, na tangval thahatte, na laate hong laksak ding a, ama inn nasem dingin amaute koih ding hi.
Amah in na tuute uh panin sawm-ah-khat hong kai ding a, nomau mahmah zong ama nasemte na suak ding uh hi.
Note aa dinga na deih uh kumpipa hangin tua ni ciangin note na kikokhia ding uh a, ahih hangin tua ni ciangin Yahweh in note hong dawng lo ding hi,” a ci hi.
Ahih hangin mite in Samuyl vauhilhna mang loin, “Hilo hi, kote hong uk ding kumpi khat ka deih uh hi.
Minam dangte khempeuh bang teekteekin ka ut uh hi. Kote thu hong khen ding leh galsimna ah hong makaih ding kumpi khat a deih uh hi,” ci-in a dawng uh hi.
Samuyl in mite kammalte khempeuh mangin, tua khit ciangin amah in Yahweh zakin tuate a genkik hi.

Tua ciangin Yahweh in Samuyl hilhin, “Amaute hong ngetnate manginla, kumpi khat seh in,” a ci hi. Tua ciangin Samuyl in Israyl mite kiangah, “Mi khempeuh na khuapi ciat uh ah ciahkik phot un,” a ci hi.
Tua hunin Benyamin mi sung panin Aphiah’ tapa Bechorath, a tapa Zeror, a tapa Abiel, a tapa Kish min nei Benyamin pasal khat a om hi.
Amah in tapa khat nei-in a min Shaul ahi hi. Amah pen zahtak huai leh a mel hoih khat hi a, Israyl mite lakah a kikimpih om loin, midang khempeuh sangin lu khat bang a sangzaw hi. (1Sam 10:23)
Tu-in Shaul’ pa Kish’ laate mang hi. Tua ahih manin Kish in a tapa Shaul kiangah, “Nasemte khat samin laate va zong un,” a ci hi.

Tua ahih ciangin Ephraim mualtung gam teng leh Shalisha kual kiim teng a zon uh hangin a muzo kei uh hi. Shaalim gam huam ah amaute pai uh a, ahih hangin a mu tuan kei uh hi. Tua ciangin Benyamin mite gam teng ah pai-in a zon hangin a muzo tuan kei uh hi.
Zuph gam a tun uh ciangin, Shaul in amah tawh a om a nasempa kiangah, “Pai in, kilehkik ni, tua hi keileh ka pa in laate lunghimawh loin eite hong lunghimawhzaw kha ding hi,” a ci hi. (1Sam 10:2)

Ahih hangin a nasempa in ama kiangah, “Na khawl o, hih khuapi sungah a kizahtak mahmah Yahweh’ mi khat om hi. Ama tangkote khempeuh tung takpi hi. Tua ahih ciangin tua lai-ah pai ni, eite in bang cih ding cih amah in hong lak kha thei ding hi,” ci-in a dawngkik hi.

Tua ciangin Shaul in a nasempa kiangah, “En in, pai le hang tua mipa bang pia ding i hi hiam? I ippi sunga ante lah beita a, Yahweh’ mipa tungah a tawi ding letsong i nei kei hi. En bang nei i hi hiam?” a ci hi.
Tua ciangin nasempa in Shaul dawngkikin, “En in, ngun shekel khat seh-li-suah-seh-khat ka nei hi. I vai hong gen nadingin Yahweh’ mipa tungah tua ka pia ding hi,” a ci hi.

(Tua ma lai-in Israyl gam sungah Yahweh kiangah thu dong dingin mi khat a pai ciangin amah in, “Hong pai in, thumupa kiang pai ni,” ci hi. Bang hang hiam cihleh tu huna kamsangte pen tua ma-in thumupa kici hi.)
Tua ciangin Shaul in a nasempa dawngin, “Na genna hoih hi! Pai ni,” a ci hi. Tua ahih manin Yahweh mipa omna khuapi ah a pai uh hi.
Khuapi zuanin mualtung ah a paitoh laitakun tui tawi dinga a pai numeino pawlkhat tawh kituak uh a, amaute kiangah, “Thumupa hiah a om hia?” a ci uh hi.
Amaute in, “Om mah, na mai uh ah pai hi. Nawh delh un, munsang ah mite’ biakpiakna khat om ahih manin tuni mahmahin ka khuapi uh ah amah hong tung hi.

Khuapi sung na lut phetun munsang ah an ne dingin a pai ma-in amah na mu ding uh hi. Amah in biakpiakna thupha pia hamtang ding ahih manin ama tun masiah mite in bangmah ne lo ding uh hi. Tua khit ciangin a kisam mite in ne pan ding uh hi. Pai un, den mahmah ciangin na mu pah ding uh hi,” ci-in a dawng uh hi.
Tua ahih manin amaute, khuapi manawhin pai uh hi. Khuapi ah amaute a lut laitakun munsang ah a pai dingin amau lam manawhin Samuyl a pai hi.
Samuyl a paikhiatma ni-in Samuyl’ zakin Yahweh in hih bangin genkhin hi:

“Zingciang tuhun mahin, Benyamin gam panin mi khat kong sawl ding hi. Ka mi Israyl-te tungah makai dingin nangmah in amah sathau na nilh ding hi; tua ahih manin amah in Philistia-te vangliatna panin Ka mite honkhia thei ding hi. Amaute kikona Ka kiang hong tungkhin ahih manin Ka mite ka mukhin zo hi,” a ci hi.
Samuyl in Shaul a muh ciangin, Yahweh in ama kiangah, “Nang tunga kong gen mipa hihpa hi. Hihpa in Ka mite uk ding hi,” a ci hi.
Tua ciangin kulhkongpi gei-a Samuyl kiangah Shaul pai-in, “Thumupa inn koi lai hiam, cih hong gen in,” a ci hi.

Samuyl in Shaul dawngin, “Thumupa kei ka hi hi. Tuni-in kei tawh an ne khawm ding na hih manin munsang lam zuanin ka mai-ah pai un. Zingciangin nang hong ciahsakin na lungsim sunga om peuhmah kong gen ding hi.

Na laate ahih leh tuma ni thum lai-in a mangsa hi a, tuate aa dingin lunghimawh kei un; bang hang hiam cihleh tuate kimukhin hi. Ahih hangin nang tung leh na pa’ innkuan khempeuh tung lo ah, Israyl-te’ lametna khempeuh a kiheina kua om ahi hiam?” a ci hi.

Tua ciangin Shaul in dawngin, “Kei pen Israyl sunga minam neupen panin Benyamin mi hi a, ka beh pen Benyamin minam sunga beh khempeuh laka a neupen ahi hi. Tua hi napi-in bang hangin kei tungah hih bangin hong ci na hi hiam?” a ci hi. (Thk 20:35, 46; 1Sam 15:17)
Tua ciangin Samuyl in innpi sungah Shaul leh a nasempa paipih a, sawmthum bang a pha—a kisamte tutna khungnungpen ah a tusak hi.
Samuyl in anhuanpa kiangah, “Na tuamkoih in, ci-a kong cih sehtanh hong lui in,” a ci hi.

Tua ahih manin anhuanpa in sakhe leh tua tunga om sa khempeuh thukin Shaul mai-ah a lui hi. Tua khit ciangin Samuyl in, “Hihte, nang aa dingin a kituamkoih ahi hi. Ne in, bang hang hiam cihleh a kisam mite a kigensa bangin tuhun dong nang aa dingin a kituamkoih ahi hi. Tua ahih manin tua ni-in Shaul in Samuyl tawh a ne hi.
Munsang panin amaute paisukin khuapi sungah a lutkhit uh ciangin, Samuyl in a innkhum tungah Shaul a hopih hi.

Khuavak kuanin amaute tho uh hi. Tua khit ciangin Samuyl in innkhum ah Shaul samin, “Kithawi un, na pai nading uh ah kong kha ding hi,” a ci hi. Shaul a kithawi khit ciangin amah leh Samuyl a pusuak khawm uh hi.

Amaute khuanawl a paisuk laitakun Samuyl in Shaul kiangah, “Na nasempa i mai-ah a pai nadingin gen in, ahih hangin hih lai-ah nang tawmvei khawl lai in, tua hileh Yahweh kiang pana thu khat nang tungah kong gen thei ding hi,” a ci hi. Tua ahih manin nasempa a paisuak hi.
Tua khit ciangin Samuyl in sathau thawl khat la-in, Shaul’ lu tungah sungsukin, amah nam a, “Yahweh in Ama gamluahte tungah makai dingin sathau hong nilhkhin hilo ahi hiam? (1Sam 15:1)

Tuni-in kei nong nusiat khit ciangin Zelzah-a Benyamin gam sunga Rachel’ han gei-ah mi nih tawh na kituak ding hi. Amaute in, ‘Na zonzon uh laate kimukhin hi. Tu-in na pa in laate lunghimawh nawn loin note hong lunghimawh hi. Amah in, Ka tapa bang cih ding ka hi hiam?’ ci-in dong hi, hong ci ding uh hi. (1Sam 9:5)

Tua ciangin tua mun panin Tabor singkung lianpi dong na tun mateng na pai ding hi. Yahweh Inn-a Yahweh kiangah a paito mi thum tawh na kituak ding uh a, khat in keelno thum pua-in, adang khat in anlum thum pua-in a khat in leenggahzu savun um khat a pua ding hi.
Amaute in nang hong hopihin anlum nih hong pia ding uh a, amau khut panin na sang ding hi.

Tua khit ciangin Philistia galvilte a omna Yahweh’ Gibeah ah na tung ding hi. Khuapi na nai ciangin, amaute mai-ah, laiza-te, khuangtate, tamngaite, harp-te tumkawmsa-in munsang panin a paisuk kamsang mihon tawh na kituak ding a, amaute in kamsang kawmkawm ding uh hi.
Tua khit ciangin nangma tungah Yahweh’ Kha hong tung ding a, amaute tawh kamsang khawmin, mi tuamdang khatin na kikhel ding hi.
Na mai panin hih limte khatvei hong tangtun ciangin, Yahweh in nang hong ompih ahih manin hong kici bangbangin hih in.

Gilgal zuanin ka mai-ah na paisuk in; meihal biaknate leh kilemna biaknate a pia dingin tua lai-ah kong paisuk taktak ding hi. Nang kiangah hong pai-in na sep ding kong lah mateng ni sagih sung pel loin nong ngak ding hi,” ci-in a gen hi. (1Sam 13:8)
Samuyl paisan dingin Shaul a kihei ciangin Yahweh in amah lungsim dangkhat guanin, tua ni-in tua limte khempeuh a tangtung hi.
