Sing lakah mite a pai uh ciangin, tua lai-ah khuaizu takkhia a om hangin kuamah in a khut tawh sawkin a kam ah ciam vet lo uh hi; bang hang hiam cihleh mite in kiciamna zahtak uh hi.

Ahih hangin a pa in kiciamna nuai ah mite a koih lam Yahnathan in za lo ahih manin a khut sunga om ciangkhut dawn tawh khuaizu dawtin, a khut tawh a kam ah a tunto hi. Tua khit ciangin a tha hong hatkik hi.

Tua ciangin mi khat in ama kiangah, “Na pa in khauh takin kiciamna khat tawh mite khih a, ‘Tu ni-in an a ne peuhmah in samsiatna ngah tahen!’ a ci hi. Tua hangin mi khempeuh a bah uh ahi hi,” a ci hi.
Ahih hangin Yahnathan in, “Ka pa in gamsung a buaisak hi. En un, hih khuaizu tawmno ka ciapna hangin ka tha hong dimkik hi.
Tuni-in mite in galte kiang pana a lakte suakta takin ne le uh bang zahtaka hoihzaw ding hiam. Tu-in Philistia-te tampi kithat zozaw lai ding hilo ahi hiam?” a ci hi.
Tua ni-in Michmash panin Aiyalon ciang dong Philistia-te a notkek khit uh ciangin, mite nak zawm mahmah ta uh hi.
Van kinusiate mite kituh henhan uh a, tuuhon, bawnghon leh bawngnote la-in lei lakah gogawp uh a, a sisan tawh nekhawm gawp uh hi.

Tua khit ciangin amaute in Shaul kiangah hih thu ko-in, “En in, nuntakna sisan tawh a nekna uh hangin Yahweh tungah mite a mawh uh hi,” a ci uh hi. Tua ciangin amah in, “Note na citak kei uh hi. Hih lai ah suangtumpi khat hong khuk pah un,” a ci hi. (Pian 9:4; Siam 7:26-27, 17:10-14, 19:26; Thkn 12:16, 12:23, 15:23)

Tua khit ciangin amah in, “Mite lak ah pai unla amaute kiangah, ‘Kuamapeuh in na tuute uh leh na bawngte uh hih lai-ah hong paipihin go unla ne un, a si tawh nekkhopna hangin Yahweh tungah mawh kei un,’ ci-in gen un,” a ci hi. Tua ahih manin tua zanin a kuamapeuh in a bawngtal uh paipihin tua lai mun ah a go uh hi.
Tua ciangin Shaul in Yahweh aa dingin biaknatau khat lam hi. Hih pen Yahweh aa dingin a lam biaknatau masa pen ahi hi.

Tua ciangin Shaul in, “Philistia-te nung ah zanin i paisuk dinga amaute khuavak dong lawkgawpin khat beek i hingkhawi kei ding hi,” a ci hi. Tua ciangin amaute in, “Nangma hoihsak bangin hih in,” a ci uh hi. Tua khit ciangin siampipa in, “Yahweh kiang dong phot ni,” a ci hi.
Tua ahih manin Shaul in Yahweh kiang dongin, “Philistia-te ka delh uh diam? Israyl-te vangliatna ah amaute nong pia ding hiam?” a ci hi. Ahih hangin Yahweh in tua ni-in dawng lo hi.
Tua ahih ciangin Shaul in, “Galkap makai note khempeuh hiah hong pai un, tuni-in bang mawhna bawl i hihiam zongkhia ni.

Israyl a hon Yahweh a nungta taktak ahih mah bangin ka tapa Yahnathan hang ahih leh, amah si taktak ding hi,” a ci hi. Ahih hangin mi khempeuh lakah kam khat beek tawh a dawngkik khat zong a om kei hi.

Tua ciangin amah in Israyl-te khempeuh kiangah, “Note hua lai-ah va ding un; kei leh ka tapa Yahnathan hih lai-ah ka ding ding uh hi,” a ci hi. Tua ciangin mite in Shaul kiangah, “Hoih nasak bangin hih in,” a ci uh hi.
Tua ciangin Shaul in Israyl’ Pa, Yahweh kiangah, “A phi man hong pia in,” ci-in thu a ngen hi. Tua ciangin ai lotna ah Yahnathan leh Shaul kila a, mite a siang hi. (Msn 27:21; 1Sam 28:6)
Tua ciangin Shaul in, “Kei leh ka tapa Yahnathan kikal ah ai lawn un,” a ci hi. Tua ciangin Yahnathan kila hi.

Tua ciangin Shaul in Yahnathan kiangah, “Bang gamta na hi hiam, hong gen in,” a ci hi. Tua ciangin Yahnathan in ama kiangah genin, “Ka khut sunga ciangkhut dawn tawh khuaizu tawmno khat bek ka ciam hi. Tu-in kei a si loh phamawh ahi hiam?” a ci hi.
Shaul in, “Yahnathan aw, nang na sih kei leh, Yahweh in a ututin kei hong bawl henla tua sangin a nasiazaw-in zong hong behlap tahen,” a ci hi.

Ahih hangin mite in Shaul kiangah, “Israyl sungah hih hotkhiatna lianpi hong ngahsak Yahnathan a si ding kilawm ahi hiam? Si peuhmah lo ding hi! Yahweh a nungta ahih mah bangin a lu tunga samzang khat nangawn leilak ah kia lo ding hi; bang hang hiam cihleh amah in tuni-in Yahweh tawh na sem khawm hi,” a ci uh hi. Tua ahih manin mite in Yahnathan honkhia uh a, amah si lo hi. (1Sam 11:13)
Tua ciangin Philistia-te nungdelhna panin Shaul ciahkikin, Philistia-te amau gam ah a pai uh hi.
Tua ahih manin Shaul in Israyl tunga ama ukna kipsakin a kiim a pama a galte Moab, Ammon, Edom, Zobah kumpite leh Philistia-te a do hi. A kiheina peuhpeuh amaute langah amah a gualzo mahmah hi.
Tua ciangin amah in galkap khawmin Amalek mite do-in, amaute a man tua mite vangliatna panin Israyl a hon hi.
Tu-in Shaul’ tapate pen Yahnathan, Yishwi leh Malchishua ahi hi. A tanute min in a uzaw Merab hi a, a nauzaw pen Michal ahi hi.
Shaul zi’ min pen Ahinoam hi a, Ahimaaz tanu ahi hi. A galkap mangpa min Abner hi a, Shaul’ pano Ner’ tapa ahi hi.
Kish pen Shaul’ pa hi a, Abner’ pa Ner pen Abiel’ tapa ahi hi. (1Khang 8:33)
Shaul nuntak sung khempeuh Philistia-te tawh kido den uh a, Shaul in a thahat a hangsan khatpeuh a muh simin, ama naseppih dingin a la pahpah hi. (1Sam 8:11)

headings.text: Yahweh in Kumpi dingin Shaul Nial

verses.text: Samuyl in Shaul kiangah, “Yahweh in a mi Israyl-te tungah kumpi dingin sathau nilh dingin kei hong sawl hi; tua ahih ciangin tu-in Yahweh kiang panin hih kammalte ngai in. (1Sam 10:1)

Vanglianpen Yahweh thugen hih bang ahi hi: “Egypt panin amaute hong paikhiat lai-in pangsimin do vatin Israyl tungah a hihna uh hangin Amalek-te tungah dan ka tat ding hi. (Pai 17:8-14; Thkn 25:17-19)
Tu-in pai unla, Amalek mite do-in, a neih khempeuh uh susia kiuhkeuh un. Amaute hingkhawi kei un. Numei pasal, naupang naungek, bawnghon, tuuhon, kalaoh leh laate that gai un,’ ci hi,” a ci hi.
Tua ahih manin Shaul in mite kaikhawmin, Telaim ah amaute sim a—khe galkap 200,000 (tul zanih) pha-in Yahdah mi 10,000 (tul sawm) pha hi.
Tua ciangin Amalek-te khuapi ah Shaul pai-in, kuam sungah a pangsimsak hi.

Tua ciangin Shaul in tua lai-a teng Ken mite kiangah, “Paikhia un, Amalek mite lak panin kihemkhia un, tua bang na hih kei uh leh amaute tawh kong susia khawm ding hi; bang hang hiam cihleh Egypt panin Israyl mite a paikhiat lai-in amaute khempeuh tungah migi uh hi,” a ci hi. Tua ahih ciangin Amalek mite kiang panin Ken mite kihemkhia uh hi.
Tua ciangin Shaul in Havilah panin Egypt nisuahna lama om Shur dong lam dung khempeuh ah Amalek mite a do hi.
Amah in Amalek mite kumpipa Agag hingmat a, ahih hangin adang mite khempeuh namsau tawh a susia manggai hi.

Ahih hangin Shaul leh a mite in Agag leh, tuu hoihpente, bawngtalte, gannote, tuunote, leh suksiat mang ngam loh uh na hoihpente khempeuh a hawi uh hi. Ahih hangin a simmawhhuaite leh a ginalote a susia beimang hi. (2-9: Pai 17:14; Thkn 25:17-19), (2-9:1Sam 28:18)
Tua ciangin Samuyl tungah Yahweh kammal hong tungin a gen inah:

“Shaul kumpi ka suahsakna hangin ka dah mahmah hi; bang hang hiam cihleh Kei hong zuihna panin amah kiheikhiazo a, Ka thupiaknate bangin sem lo hi,” a ci hi. Hih in Samuyl zong dahsakin, zan tawntungin Yahweh tungah a kiko hi.

Shaul tawh kimu dingin a zingciang zingsang tuungin Samuyl a thawh ciangin, “Carmel ah Shaul pai hi. Tua lai-ah amah mah kipahtawina-in phawkna mualsuang khat phut a, amah kihei-in Gilgal ah a paisuk hi,” ci-in Samuyl kiangah hih thu a kigen hi.
Tua ciangin Shaul kiangah Samuyl pai-in, Shaul in ama kiangah, “Yahweh’ mi nangmah in thupha ngah ta in! Yahweh’ thupiakna ka semkhin hi,” a ci hi.
Ahih hangin Samuyl in, “Tua ahih leh ka bil-a ka zak tuu hamte leh ka zak bawngtal hamte bang ahi hiam?” a ci hi.

Tua ciangin Shaul in, “Amalek mite kiang panin amaute in hong paipihte ahi hi; bang hang hiam cihleh Yahweh na Pa tungah biakpiak nadingin tuu leh bawng hoihpente mite in hingkhawi uh hi. Adangte ka susia kiuhkeuhkhin uh hi,” a ci hi.
Tua ciangin Samuyl in Shaul kiangah, “Pau nawn kei in! Zan nitakin Yahweh in kei tungah hong gen thu nang kong gen ding hi,” a ci hi. Tua ciangin ama kiangah, “Gen in,” a ci hi.

Tua ahih ciangin Samuyl in, “Nang le nang na kineu ngaihsun hun lai-in, tu-in Israyl minamte’ lutang hilo na hi hiam? Israyl khempeuh tungah kumpi-in Yahweh in nang sathau hong nilh hilo ahi hiam? (1Sam 9:21)
Tu-in Yahweh in nasem khat nang hong sawlin, ‘Pai inla, tua mimawhte ahi Amalek mite susia beisiang in, amaute a bei mateng va simgawp in,’ hong ci hi.
Tua hi napi-in bang hangin Yahweh thu mang lo na hi hiam? Bang hangin van kinusia bawhin, Yahweh muhna ah a sia gamta na hi hiam?” a ci hi.
Tua ciangin Shaul in Samuyl kiangah, “Yahweh thu mang mah ing. Yahweh in kei hong sawl nasepna ah ka pai a, Amalek kumpipa Agag kong ciahpih hi. Amalek mite ka susia kiuhkeuhkhin hi.
Ahih hangin Gilgal ah Yahweh na Pa tungah biakpiak nadingin mite in van kinusiate, tuute, bawngtalte, suksiat mang ding na hoihpente la uh hi,” a ci hi.

Tua ciangin Samuyl in, “Yahweh’ thu manna hangin lungkim zahin meihal biaknate leh biakpiaknate ah Yahweh nakpi takin lungkim ahi hiam? En ifn, biakpiakna sangin thumanna hoihzaw a, tuutal thaute sangin thusimna hoihzaw hi. (Isa 1:11-15)

Bang hang hiam cihleh lehdona pen aisan mawhna bang hi a, lungkhauhna pen gamtatsiatna leh pasian-biakna (elohim biakna) mawh tawh a kibang ahi hi. Nangmah in Yahweh kammal na nialkhin a, Amah in zong kumpi hihna panin nang hong nialkhin hi,” a ci hi.

Tua ciangin Shaul in Samuyl kiangah, “Yahweh thupiakna leh nangma kammalte palsatkhin ka hih manin ka mawhzo hi; bang hang hiam cihleh keimah in mite ka kihtazaw kha a, amaute tungah ka phalkha hi. (1-24: 1Khang 10:13)
Tu-in hehpihna tawh ka mawhna hong maisak inla, Yahweh ka biak theih nadingin kei hong zui in,” a ci hi.

Ahih hangin Samuyl in Shaul kiangah, “Nang kong zui kei ding hi; bang hang hiam cihleh nangmah in Yahweh kammal na nialkhin a, Yahweh in Israyl tunga kumpi hihna panin nang hong nialkhin hi,” a ci hi. (1Sam 16:1)
7 Paisan dingin Samuyl a kihei laitakin Shaul in a puanpi mong manin, balkekkha hi.

Samuyl in ama kiangah, “Tuni-in nang kiang panin Israyl kumpi-gam Yahweh in balkhiazo a, na sanggamte khat, nang sangin a hoihzaw khat tungah piazo hi. (2Sam 3:9-10), (27-28: 1Sam 28:17, 1Kum 11:30-31)

Israyl-te thahatna ahi Amah zuau lo a, Amah in a lungsim zong khel lo ding hi. Bang hang hiam cihleh a lungsim a khel dingin Yahweh pen mihing hilo hi,” a ci hi. (Eze 24:14; 1Sam 28:17; 1Kum 11:11,31)
Tua ciangin Shaul in, “Ka mawhzo hi. Ahih hangin ka mipih upate mai leh Israyl-te mai-ah hong pahtawi in; Yahweh na Pa ka biak theih nadingin hong zuikik in,” a ci hi.
Tua ahih manin Shaul tawh Samuyl paikikin, Shaul in Yahweh a bia hi.

Tua ciangin Samuyl in, “Amalek mite kumpipa Agag ka kiangah hong paikhiatpih un,” a ci hi. Ama kiangah lau-in lingkawmsa-in Agag hong pai-in ahih hangin, “Sihsia-a sihna bei taktak ta hinteh,” ci-in a ngaihsun hi.

Ahih hangin Samuyl in, “Na namsau in nupite ta nei loin a bawlkhit bang teekteekin, nupite lakah na nu zong ta nei lo hi ding hi!” a ci hi. Tua khit ciangin Samuyl in Gilgal-a Yahweh mai-ah Agag a satzan hi. (Pian 9:6; Thk 1:7)
Tua khit ciangin Ramah ah Samuyl pai a, Gibeah-a a inn ah Shaul a ciahto hi.

Shaul a sih ni dongin amah tawh kimu dingin Samuyl pai nawn lo hi. Tua bang ahih hangin Shaul hangin Samuyl a kap hi; ahih hangin Israyl tungah kumpi-in Shaul a bawlna hangin Yahweh a dah hi. (1Sam 15:11, 16:1, 19:24)

Tua ciangin Yahweh in Samuyl kiangah, “Israyl tungah kumpi hihna panin Shaul ka nial khitna mu-in Shaul hangin bang tanvei kapkap ding na hi hiam? Na saki sungah sathau thun inla pai in. Bethlehem-a Yishai kiangah nang kong sawl ding hi; bang hang hiam cihleh a tapate lak panin Keima aa dingin ka teel khin hi,” a ci hi. (1Sam 15:26; Heb 11:32)

Ahih hangin Samuyl in, “Bangci pai theih ding ka hi hiam? Shaul in hih thu za leh, amah in kei hong that ding hi,” a ci hi. Tua ciangin Yahweh in, “Bawngla khat la inla, ‘Yahweh tungah biakpiakna pia dingin kong pai hi,’ ci in,” a ci hi.
Tua ciangin biakpiakna ah Yishai sam inla, na gamtat dingzia kong lak ding hi; nang tungah a min kong genpa Kei aa dingin sathau nong nilhsak ding ahi hi.
Tua ahih manin Yahweh gen bangin Samuyl in hih a, Bethlehem ah a pai hi. Khuapi upate in amah a muh ciangin amaute ling uh a, “Thuhoih-a hong pai na hi hiam?” a ci uh hi.

Tua ciangin amah in, “Shalom!; Nopna hong tung tahen!, Yahweh tungah biakpiakna pia dingin hong pai ka hi hi. Kisiansuahin ki-ap unla, biakpiakna ah kei tawh hong pai un,” a ci hi. Tua khit ciangin amah in Yishai leh a tapate siansuahin ap a, biakpiakna ah amaute a sam hi.
Amaute hong pai ciangin amah in Eliab enin, “Yahweh’ sathau nilhpa Ama mai-ah hong ding taktak hi,” ci-in a ngaihsun hi.

Ahih hangin Yahweh in Samuyl kiangah, “Ama duang leh ama thasanna en kei in; bang hang hiam cihleh amah ka nialsa hi. Mite in nate a et bangin Yahweh in en lo hi; bang hang hiam cihleh mite in a kilangkhia a puatham en a, ahih hangin Yahweh in a lungsim en hi,” a ci hi. (Iy 10:4)
Yishai in Abinadab samin Samuyl mai-ah paisak a, ahih hangin Samuyl in, “Yahweh in hihpa teel lo hi,” a ci hi.
Tua khit ciangin Yishai in Samuyl mai-ah Shammah paisak a, ahih hangin Samuyl in, “Yahweh in hihpa teel lo hi,” a ci hi.
Hih bangin Yishai in Samuyl mai-ah a ding dingin a tapa sagihte paisak a, ahih hangin Samuyl in Yishai kiangah, “Yahweh in hihte teel lo hi,” a ci hi.

Tua ciangin Samuyl in Yishai kiangah, “Na tapa neih khempeuh hih teng ahi hiam?” a ci hi. Tua ciangin amah in, “A nautum penpa om lai hi, ahih hangin amah in tuu cing lai hi,” a ci hi. Samuyl in Yishai kiangah, “Amah samsak inla, ka mai-ah hong paisak in; bang hang hiam cihleh hih tengah amah hong tun matengin Yahweh biakpiakna an ne dingin i kikaikhawm nai kei ding hi,” a ci hi. Tua ahih manin Yishai in David samsakin, Yahweh biakpiakna an ne dingin amah hong tumpih hi. Amah pen a cisan suakin a maisuah kilawm a, a mel hoihin a duang kitawi linlian hi.
Tua ciangin Yahweh in, “Ding inla, sathau nilh in. Amah pen kong genpa hi,” a ci hi. (1Sam 17:42; Late 89:20; Sawl 13:22), (11-12: Late 78:70-71)

Tua ahih manin Samuyl in sathau koihna saki la-in a sanggam pasalte omin amah sathau nilh a, tua ni-a kipanin David tungah Yahweh’ Kha khauhtakin hong tung hi. Tua khit ciangin Samuyl dingto-in Ramah ah a ciah hi. (11-13: 1Khang 17:7)
Ahih hangin Yahweh’ Kha in Shaul nusiazo a, Yahweh in amah a gimsak dingin kha gilo a phal hi.
Shaul’ nasemte in ama kiangah, “Kha gilo in nang hong lunggimsak taktak hi.

Na mai-a om na nasemte in harp tumsiam mi khat ka zon nadingun ka ukpa aw na nasemte thu hong pia in. Kha gilo in nang hong lunggimsak ciangin ama khut in harp tum ding a, tua ciangin na nuamtuam ding hi,” a ci uh hi.
Tua ahih manin Shaul in a nasemte thupia-in, “Hoih taka a tum thei mi khat zong unla, ka kiangah hong paipih un,” a ci hi.

Tua ciangin a nasemte khat in dawngin, “Bethlehem khua a Yishai’ tapa a tumsiam mahmah khat ka mu hi. Amah pen a hangsan mi khat hi a, galdo siam khat ahi hi. Amah thugen siamin, a mel hoih mi khat ahi hi. Tua banah Yahweh in amah ompih hi,” a ci hi.
Tua ciangin Shaul in Yishai kiangah kamtaite sawlin, “Tuute tawh a om na tapa David ka kiangah hong sawl in,” a ci hi.
Tua ciangin Yishai in laa khat la-in anlum, leenggahzu savun um khat leh keelno khat puasakin a tapa David tawh Shaul kiangah amaute a sawl hi.
Tua ciangin Shaul kiangah amah tungin ama nasemin om a, Shaul in amah pakta mahmahin ama galhiam tawipa a suak hi.
Tua ciangin Shaul in Yishai kiangah thu puakin, “David in ka maipha hong mu ahih manin ka nasepna ah David a omlai ding hong phal in,” a ci hi.
Tua ahih manin Shaul tungah kha gilo a tun simin David in a harp la-in hoih takin a tum hi. Tua ciangin Shaul in thangahin, amah nuamtuam a, kha gilo in amah a nusia hi.
Yahdah gam Socoh ah galsim dingin Philistia-te in a galkapte uh a kaikhawm uh hi. Amaute in Socoh leh Azekah kikal-a Ephes Dammim ah giahphual a sat uh hi.
Shaul leh Israyl mite kikaikhawmin, Elah Kuam ah giahphual sat uh a, Philistia-te tawh kido dingin a kigual uh hi. (2Sam 21:19)
Philistia-te a gal mualtung ah omin, Israyl-te adang mualtung khat ah om uh a, amaute kikal ah kuam khat a om hi.
Philistia-te giahphual panin Gath khua mi a tun cubit 6 leh khap khat; pi 9 leh letmat 9 bang, a sang a min Goliath kici khat hong paikhia hi.
Amah in a lu tungah sumngo lukhu khat khu-in, shekel 5,000 a gik sumngo galdal puan khat a silh hi.
Amah in a khete tungah sumngo ngaltuam bulh a, a liangko kikalah sumngo teipi-khawh khat a nei hi.
A teipi bul siam lawngpi tawh kibang a, a sik teipi-dawn pen shekel 6,000 gikin, a mai-ah a lum puapa a pai hi.

Goliath hong paikhia-in ding a, Israyl galkapte otsanin, “Bang hangin galsim dingin hong kuanin kigual tazen na hi uh hiam? Kei Philistia mi khat hilo ka hi hiam? No Shaul nasemte hilo na hi uh hiam? No aa dingin mi khat teel unla, ka kiangah hong sawlkhia un.

Amah in kei hong do-in hong thah zawh leh, kote no’ ukna nuai mi ka suak ding uh hi; ahih hangin keimah in amah zo-in ka thah leh, note ko’ ukna nuai mi na hi ding uh a, kote’ na na sem ding uh hi,” a ci hi.
Tua ciangin Philistia mipa in, “Tuni-in keimah in Israyl galkapte a ngap peuh kong to hi. Khat le khat ka kilai theih nadingun mi khat hong pia un,” a ci hi.
Shaul leh Israyl khempeuh in Philistia mipa’ kammalte a zak uh ciangin, amaute lungkia-in a lau mahmah uh hi.
Tu-in David pen Yahdah gam Bethlehem gam pana Ephraim mi tapa giat a nei Yishai’ tapa khat ahi hi. Shaul hun lai-in amah khangham ta-in a kum zong tamta hi.
Yishai’ tapa upen thumte in galsimna ah Shaul a zui dingin a kuankhin uh hi. Tua tapa thumte min in: Eliab a upen, Abinadab a nihna, Shammah a thumna ahi hi.
David pen a nautumpen ahi hi. A upen thumte in Shaul a zui uh hi.
Bethlehem-a a pa’ tuute cing dingin Shaul kiang panin David kuanzelin a ciahzel hi.
Tua ciangin ni 40 sung zing leh nitakin Philistia mi Goliath hong pai-in a to zel hi.
Tua ciangin Yishai in a tapa David kiangah, “Hih ankan ephah khat leh anlum sawm la inla, giahphual-a na sanggamte kiangah manlang takin va puak in.
Amau tunga a tul ukpa kiangah hih nawithaukhal sawmte puak khawmin, na sanggamte’ galsimna bangci hiam cih va en inla, amaute thu kei kiangah hong puakkik in,” a ci hi.
Elah Kuam sungah Philistia-te tawh Shaul, amaute leh Israyl mite khempeuh kido-in a om uh hi.

Tua ciangin zingsangin David thobaihin, tuute a cing khat tawh nusia-in, Yishai in amah a hilhsa bangin a ante guangin a dingkhia hi. Amaute awngin gal kidona ah galkapte a kuankhit deuh ciangin giahphual ah David a tung hi.
Israyl-te leh Philistia-te khat le khat kimaingatsa-in kigualin a kinaih uh hi.
David in vancingpa kiangah a vante nusia-in, gal kidona ah tai-in a sanggamte a hopih hi.
Amaute tawh a kiho laitakin, Gath khuami a min Goliath kici Philistia mipa, Philistia galkapte kiang panin hong paikhia hi. Amah in a masa-a mah bangin to-in awng a, David in a za hi.
Israyl mite khempeuh in tua mipa a muh uh ciangin, ama kiang panin taimangin, a kihta lua mahmah uh hi.

Tu-in Israyl mite in, “Hih mipa hong paikhiat denkeei na mu uh hia? Amah in Israyl-te a ngap peuh a to dingin hong paikhia den hi. Kumpipa in hihpa a thatzo mipa tungah hauhna lianpi pia ding a, amah in a tanu tawh kitengsakin, Israyl sung panin a pa innkuante siah kipengsak ding hi,” ci-in a kihoho uh hi.

Tua ciangin David in ama zom-a a ding mipa kiangah, “Hih Philistia mipa thatin, Israyl-te kiang panin zumhuaina leh mindaina a lakhiazo mipa aa dingin bang kicih ding hiam? A nungta vantung Pa’ galkapte a ututin a to ngam dingin hih vun-at loh Philistiapa kua hi lel ahi hiam?” a ci hi.
Mite in amah dawngin, “Amaute in a gensa thu mah uh genkikin: Amah a thatzo mipa aa dingin hih bangin kihihsak ding hi,” a ci uh hi.

Amah in mite a hopih ciangin a sanggam upenpa Eliab in za a, David tungah Eliab nakpi takin heh hi. Tua ciangin amah in, “Bang hangin hiah hong paisuk na hi hiam? Gamsunga i tuu tawmnote kua tawh nusia na hi hiam? A hi mahmah ding kisa-in na kihai muan hi! Gal kidona en ding beka hiah hong pai hi teh!” a ci hi.
David in, “Tu’n ken bang hih ka hia? Hih bang nong cih nadingin ken bang hih ka hia?” a ci hi.
Tua khit ciangin Eliab kiang panin mi dang khat lamah kiheisanin tua thu mah gen a, mite in a masate cih bang mahin na dawng uh hi.
David kampaute a kizak ciangin Shaul kiangah kiko a, Shaul in a samsak hi.
David in Shaul kiangah, “Hih Philistia mipa hangin kuamah lungkiasak kei in. Keima na nasempa pai-in ka do ding hi,” a ci hi.
Shaul in David kiangah, “Hih Philistia pa na do ding bel hi thei kei. Nang naupang no lel khat na hi a, amah pen a khangno tunga kipanin galdodo mi khat ahi hi,” a ci hi.
Ahih hangin David in Shaul kiangah, “Na nasempa in a pa’ tuute cing den hi. Humpi ahi a, vompi ahi zongin hong pai-in ganhon laka tuute a tuahkhit ciangin,
keimah in nungdelhin ka sat a, a kam panin tuute ka honkhia hi. Kei hong bawh ciangin a mul panin ka man a, satin ka that hi.

Na nasempa in humpi hitaleh vompi hitaleh a nihin ka that ngei hi. Hih vun-at loh Philistia-pa in a nungta vantung Pa’ galkapte a ututin toto vial ahih leh hihte khat tawh kibang lel ding hi,” a ci hi.

David in cih beh lai-in, “Humpi khecin pan leh vompi khecin pana hong honkhia Yahweh in hih Philistia-pa khut panin kei hong hon ding hi,” a ci hi. Tua ciangin Shaul in David kiangah, “Pai in, Yahweh in nang hong ompih hen!” a ci hi.
Shaul in galkuan dingin David kithawisak a, galdal puan silhsakin sumngo lukhu a khusak hi.

David in galdal puan tungah a namsau khih a, tuate tawh amah kisek lo ahih manin kisinin a pai kawikawi hi. David in Shaul kiangah, “Hihte tawh ka pai thei kei hi, bang hang hiam cihleh hihte tawh ka zang ngei kei hi,” a ci hi. Tua ahih ciangin David in a suahkhia hi.
Tua ciangin amah in a khut sungah a ciangkhut la-in, lui panin suangmai tang nga tengin, a tuucin thungpi sungah tuate koih a, a khut sungah a sunglotna tawi-in Philistia-pa nai-ah a pai hi.
Tua ciangin Philistia-pa, ama mai-ah a kidalna lum a puapa tawh hong paikhia a, David kiang nai-ah a neh ding kipan hi.
Philistia-pa in David a etet ciangin, a zahpih hi. Amah in a cisan suak a melhoih khangno khat ahihna bek a mu hi.
Philistia-pa in David kiangah, “Kei hong langpan dingin ciang tawh nong kuankhiat ui hongsa na hi hiam?” a ci hi. Tua ciangin Philistia-pa in ama pasiante’ (elohim) minte tawh a samsia hi.
Tua ciangin Philistia-pa in David kiangah, “Hiah hong pai in, huih lak vasate leh gamlak gamsate tungah na sa ka pia ding hi,” a ci hi.

Tua ciangin David in Philistia-pa kiangah, “Namsau, teipi leh lum tawh kei kiangah nong kuan hi. Ahih hangin kei pen nangmah in na ututin na toto Israyl galkapte’ Thahatna, Vanglianpen Yahweh Min tawh kong kuan hi.

Tuni-in Yahweh in keima khut sungah nang hong pia ding a, keimah in nang hong satin na kiang panin na lutang ka lakhia ding hi. Tuni-in huih lak vasate leh leitung gamsate tungah Philistia-te giahphual-a misi luangte ka pia ding hi; tua ahih manin leitung khempeuh in Israyl sungah Vanglian Pa khat a om lam thei ding uh hi.
Yahweh in namsau leh teipi tawh a huut loh lam hih lai-a a kikaikhawmte khempeuh in thei ding uh hi; bang hang hiam cihleh gal kidona pen Yahweh aa hi a, Amah in ko khut sungah note hong pia ding hi.
Philistia-pa in amah do dingin a neh semsemna tawh kizui-in David zong Philistia-pa tawh kimaituah dingin gal mai-ah manlang takin a tai hi.
Tua ciangin David in a thungip sungah a khut sawkin, suangtang khat la a, a kap ciangin Philistia-pa’ taltang a kha hi. A taltang ah tua suangtang tumsukin, leilak ah a maipuksuk hi.
Tua ahih manin David in suanglotna khat leh suangtang khat tawh Philistia-pa zo a, Philistia-pa satin a that hi. Ahih hangin David khut sungah namsau omlo hi.

Tua ahih ciangin David tai-in Philistia mipa tungah ding a, amah in Philistia-pa namsau manin a paai panin a dokkhia a, amah in thah khit ciangin tua tawh a lutang a satkhia hi. Philistia-te in a mipa uh a sihna a muh uh ciangin, a taimang uh hi.

Israyl mite leh Yahdah-te dingto-in awng ziahziah uh a, kuam lutna leh Ekron kulhkongpite dong Philistia-te a delh uh hi. Gath leh Ekron dong Shaaraim lam lianpi dung tawntungah misi luangte a kithehthang hi.
Tua ciangin Philistia-te nungdelhna panin Israyl mite kilehkik uh a, a puanbukte uh a luhsak hi.
David in Philistia mipa’ lutang la-in Yerusalem ah pua a, ahih hangin amah in Philistia-pa’ galhiamte a puanbuk sungah a koih hi.

Philistia-pa langah kuanin David a paina Shaul in a muh ciangin, a galkap mangpa Abner kiangah, “Abner, hih naupang kua tapa ahi hiam?” ci-in a dong hi. Tua ciangin Abner in, “Kumpipa aw, nangmah na nungta a, ka thei kei hi,” a ci hi.
Tua khit ciangin kumpipa in, “Amah kua tapa hiam, cih hong kan un,” a ci hi.
Tua ciangin Philistia-pa a thahna panin David hong ciahna tawh kizui-in Abner in samin, a khut sungah Philistia-pa lutang tawi kawmin Shaul mai-ah a paipih hi.
Tua ciangin Shaul in ama kiangah, “Tangvalnopa aw, kua tapa na hi hiam?” a ci hi. Tua ciangin David in, “Bethlehem mi na nasem Yishai’ tapa ka hi hi,” ci-in a dawng hi.
Shaul tawh kiho a man khit ciangin Yahnathan lungsim David aa tawh pum khat bang a, Yahnathan in ama pumpi a it bangin David a it hi.
Shaul in tua ni-a kipanin ama kiangah omsakin, ama omna a pa’ inn ah ciah ding a phal nawn kei hi.
Tua ciangin Yahnathan in amah in ama pumpi a it bangin David a it ahih manin David tawh thuciamna khat a bawl hi.
Yahnathan in a silh kimlai a puantualpi suahkhia-in David pia a, a galhiam, a namsau, a thal leh a kawnggak-te nangawn tawh a pia hi.
Shaul in amah a sawlna peuhpeuh ah David pai a, David in pilvang takin a sem hi. Tua ahih manin Shaul in gal sung mite tungah amah koih a, mi khempeuh leh Shaul’ uliante in amah a pakta uh hi.

David in Philistia-pa that khinin mite inn ah a ciah ciangin kumpipa Shaul dawn dingin Israyl khuapite khempeuh panin laamna leh lasakna, lungnopna late leh khuangtate, khausai tumtheihte tum kawmin hong pusuak uh hi.
Tua ciangin numeite in a laam kawmin lasa uh a, “Shaul in a tultul that, David in a thenthen that,” a ci uh hi.

Tua ciangin Shaul a heh hi; hih thugenna in amah lungkimsak lo hi. Amah in, “Amaute in David a thenthenin minphatna pia uh a, kei tung ciangin a tultul bekin minphatna hong pia uh hi. Kumpi-gam simloh bang nei nawn ka hi hiam?” a ci hi.
Tua ahih ciangin Shaul in tua ni-a kipanin David encik den hi.

A zingciang mahmahin Shaul tungah kha gilo khauhtakin a tun nadingin kiphal a, a inn sungah amah in kam a sang hi. David in ni danga mah bangin tumging tum a, ahi zongin Shaul’ khut ah teipi khat a om hi.
Shaul in, “Kawm tawh David ka khawh khawm ding hi,” ci-in ngaihsun ahih manin amah in teipi tawh khauh takin a khawh hi. Ahih hangin David in nihvei pelh hi.
Tu-in Yahweh in David ompihin, Shaul taisan khin ahih manin Shaul in David a kihta hi.
Tua ahih ciangin amah in a kiang panin David sawlkhia-in, mi tul khat tungah a uk dingin koih a, mite mai-ah amaute makaih-in kuankhia-in hong ciah hi.
David in a nasepna khempeuh ah pilvang takin gamta a, Yahweh in amah a ompih hi.
Shaul in amah a pil mahmahna a muh ciangin, David a kihta hi.
Ahih hangin Israyl khempeuh leh Yahdah-te in David a it uh hi; bang hang hiam cihleh amaute mai-ah amah in amaute makaih-in a ciahpihkik hi.

Tua ciangin Shaul in David kiangah, “Ka tanu upazaw Merab hiah om hi; Na kitenpih dingin nang hong pia hi; keima’ na bek hangsan takin hong sem inla, Yahweh’ gal do in,” a ci hi. Bang hang hiam cihleh Shaul in, “Ama tungah ka khut ka liik kei ding a, Philistia-te khut ka susak ding hi,” ci-in a ngaihsun hi.
David in Shaul kiangah, “Kumpipa’ makpa a suak liang dingin kei in kua hi a, Israyl sungah ka innkuan ahi a, ka pa’ beh in bang hi lel ahi hiam?” a ci hi.
Ahi zongin David kiangah Shaul’ tanu Merab kipiak ding hun hong tun ciangin, kitenpih dingin Moholath mi Adriel tungah tuanu a kipia hi.
Tu-in Shaul’ tanu Michal in David a ngai hi. Shaul kiangah hih thu a gen uh ciangin, hih thu in amah a lungkimsak hi.

Shaul in, “Ama tungah ka tanu ka pia ding hi, tua hileh ama aa dingin thangzak hikha thei ding hi; tua ahih ciangin Philistia-te in amah langpan zo thei ding hi,” a ci hi. Tua ahih manin Shaul in David kiangah a nihveina genin, “Tu-in ka makpa na suakthei ta ding hi,” a ci hi.

Tua ciangin Shaul in a nasemte thupia-in, “David amah guak tuam hopih unla, ‘Nang tungah kumpipa lungkim-in a nasemte khempeuh in zong nang hong pakta uh hi. Tu-in kumpipa’ makpa suak hoh in,’ ci un” a ci hi.

Tua ahih ciangin Shaul’ nasemte in David kiangah hih thu teng gen uh a, ahih hangin David in, “Kumpipa’ makpa suah ding thu neuno sa na hi uh hiam? Kei pen mi zawng khat ka hi a, mi minthang ka hi kei hi,” a ci hi.
Tua ciangin Shaul’ nasemte in Shaul zasakin, “Hih bangin David in hong dawng hi,” a ci uh hi.

Tua ciangin Shaul in, “Hih bangin David kiangah gen un, ‘Kumpipa in moman bangmah hong ngen lo hi, ahih hangin kumpipa’ galte tungah phu lakna-in Philistia-te vun-dawn zakhat hong ngen hi,’ ci un,” a ci hi. Bang hang hiam cihleh hih in Philistia-te khutin David puksak kha ding hi, ci-in Shaul in a ngaihsun hi.
A nasemte in hih thute David a gen uh ciangin, kumpipa’ makpa suah ding amah a lungkim hi. Tua ahih ciangin a kiseh hun a bei ma-in,

David leh a mite paikhia-in Philistia-te mi 200 a that uh hi. David in a vun-dawnte pua-in, kumpipa’ makpa a suah theih nadingin amaute in kumpipa kiangah a cingin tuate a pia uh hi. Tua ciangin Shaul in kitenpih dingin a tanu Michal a pia hi.
Yahweh in David ompihna leh Shaul’ tanu Michal in amah a itna mu-in a tel semsem ciangin,
Shaul in David a kihta semsem lai hi. Shaul nuntak omlai hun tengin Shaul pen David gal a suak hi.
Philistia galkap mangte galsim dingin kuankhia uh a, amaute a kuankhiat simin, David gualzo zaw den ahih manin a min a kizahtak semsem hi.
Shaul in David a thah nadingun a tapa Yahnathan leh a nasemte kiangah a gen hi; ahih hangin Yahnathan in David a it mahmah hi.
Yahnathan in David hilhkholin, “Ka pa Shaul in nang hong thah theih nading hun hoih khat zong hi. Zingsang mateng kigalgingsa-in om inla, mun simtham khat ah pai-in kibu in.
Na kibukna lo ah kei leh ka pa hong pai-in ka ding ding uh hi. Ama kiangah nangma thu ka gen ding a, ka muh bangin nang kong gen ding hi,” a ci hi.

Tua ciangin Yahnathan in a pa Shaul kiangah David a hoih theithei-in genin, “Kumpipa aw na nasem David tungah mawh kei in, bang hang hiam cihleh nang tungah amah hong mawh lo a, ama nasepna in nang aa dingin phattuamna tampi nei hi.

Amah in a khut sungah ama nuntakna khamin Philistia-pa that a, Yahweh in Israyl khempeuh aa dingin hotkhiatna lianpi pia hi. Nang zong hih thu mu-in na lungdam hi. Tua hi napi-in bang hangin thu omlo pi-in David thahna tawh mawhbaang lo mipa tungah mawh ding na hi hiam?” a ci hi.
Tua ahih ciangin Shaul in Yahnathan thu ngai-in, Shaul kiciam a, “Yahweh nungta taktak ahih mah bangin, amah kithat lo ding hi,” a ci hi.
Tua ciangin Yahnathan in David samin, Yahnathan in Shaul kiangah David paipih a, ni danga mah bangin Shaul’ omna ah a om hi.
Gal khatvei kido leuleu a, David kuankhia-in Philistia-te tawh a kido hi. Amah in amaute a taikek zah dongin khauh takin a vatgawp hi.
Ahih hangin Shaul in a khut sungah teipi tawi-in a inn sungah a tut laitakin Yahweh in Shaul tungah kha gilo a tun ding phal hi. Tua ciangin David in tumging a tum laitak ahi hi.
Shaul in a teipi-in kawm tawh David khawhcip dingin hanciam a, ahih hangin amah in na pelhin, kawm tungah a teipi kiphut hi. Tua zanin David tai-in a suakta hi.

Shaul in David inn encik ding leh a zingsang ciangin amah a that dingin mi a sawl hi. Ahih hangin David’ zi Michal in amah genin, “Tu zanin na nuntakna na hut kei leh, zingciangin nang hong kithat ding hi,” a ci hi.
Tua ahih manin Michal in tawlet panin David tuaksakin, amah pai-in tai a, a suakta hi.
Tua ciangin Michal in milim (teraph) khat la-in a lupna tungah a lumsak hi. Amah in puan khat tawh khuh a, a lu santak ah keelmul pawlkhat a koih hi.
Shaul in David man dingin mi a sawl ciangin, tuanu in, “Amah a cina hi,” a ci hi.
Tua ciangin Shaul in David kiangah mi sawlkikin, “Amah ka thah theih nadingin a lupna tawh kei kiangah amah hong puato un,” a ci hi.
A kisawl mite a luttum uh ciangin, lupna tungah milim (teraph) khat omin a lu santak ah keelmul pawlkhat a om hi.

Shaul in Michal kiangah, “Bang hangin hih bangin hong khemin, ka galpa a suahtak nadingin paikhiasak na hi hiam?” a ci hi. Tua ciangin Michal in Shaul dawngin, “Amah in kei kiangah, ‘Hong paikhiasak in. Bang hangin nang hong that ding ka hi hiam?’ hong ci hi,” a ci hi.
Tua ahih manin David tai-in suakta a, Ramah-a Samuyl kiangah pai-in, Shaul in ama tungah a bawlna khempeuh a gen hi. Tua ciangin amah leh Samuyl pai-in Naioth ah a om uh hi.
Shaul kiangah, “Ramah-a Naioth ah David a om lam thei in,” ci-in hih thu a kiko hi.

Tua ciangin Shaul in David a man dingin mi sawl hi. Ahih hangin kamsang honte kamsangin amaute mai-ah makai-in Samuyl a dinna amaute in a muh uh ciangin, Shaul mi sawlte tungah Yahweh’ Kha hong tungin, amaute in zong kam a sang uh hi.
Shaul kiangah hih thu a kikoh ciangin, amah in mi dang sawl a, amaute zong tua mah bangin kam a sang uh hi. Tua ciangin Shaul in a thumveina mi sawlin, amaute in zong kam a sang uh hi.

A tawpna ah amah ngiat Ramah ah pai-in Sechu-a kulh lianpi ah a tung hi. Tua lai-ah amah in, “Samuyl leh David koi-ah om ahi hiam?” ci-in a dong hi. Ama kiangah, “Ramah-a Naioth ah amaute om taktak uh hi,” ci-in a kigen hi.
Tua ahih manin tua lai panin amah dingkhia-in, Ramah-a Naioth ah a pai hi. Tua ciangin ama tungah zong Yahweh’ Kha hong tungin, Ramah-a Naioth a tun matengin amah kamsang kawmkawmin a pai hi.

Amah in a puantualpite suahkhia-in, Samuyl omna ah amah in zong kam a sang hi. Tua sun tawntung leh tua zan tawntungin a guaktangin a om hi. Hih thu hangin amaute in, “Shaul zong kamsangte lakah kihel ahi hiam?” a ci uh hi. (1Sam 10:11)

Tua ciangin Ramah-a Naioth panin David tai-in, Yahnathan kiangah pai a, “Ke’n bang hih ka hi hiam? Ka gamtat khialhna bang ahi hiam? Na pa in thah dingin kei hong zon liang nadingin ama mai-ah ka mawhna bang ahi hiam?” ci-in a dong hi.

Yahnathan in ama kiangah, “Cikmahin tua bang na gamta kei hi! Na si peuhmah kei ding hi! A taktakin, ka pa in thu lian ahi a, thu neu ahi zongin kei theih lohin a hih khat beek om lo hi. Bang hangin kei tungah hih hong im ding ahi hiam? Hih thu bel man lo hi!” a ci hi.

Ahih hangin David kiciamin, “Nang mit ah maipha ka muh lam na pa in teltakin thei a, amah in, ‘Hih thu Yahnathan theisak kei un, tua bang hikei leh amah dah lua kha ding hi,’ a ci hi. Ahih hangin a taktakin, Yahweh nungta taktakin nang na nungta a, ahih hangin kei leh sihna kikalah kal khat bek a om hi,” a ci hi.
Tua ciangin Yahnathan in David kiangah, “Na deih bangbangin nang aa dingin kong sepsak ding hi,” a ci hi.

David in Yahnathan kiangah, “A taktakin, zingciang pen Kha Det ni hi a, kumpipa tawh nitak ankuang umin a tu khawm dingin ka um hi. Ahih hangin a ni thumna ni nitak dong gamlak ah ka kibuh theih nadingin kei hong paisak in.

Na pa in kei hong kan leh, ama kiangah, ‘David in a khuapi Bethlehem ah manlangin a pai theih nadingin kei kiangah phalna limtakin hong ngen hi; bang hang hiam cihleh amau beh buppi aa dingin kumsim biakpiakna a kibawl laitak ahi hi,’ ci-in hong gensak in.
Amah in, ‘Hoih mahmah hi,’ ci-in hong dawnkik leh, na nasempa a suakta ka hi ding hi. Ahih hangin amah hong heh leh, kei hong nasak nuam takpi ahihlam na tel ding hi.

Nang na hih leh na nasempa tungah hong migi in; bang hang hiam cihleh Yahweh mai-ah nang tawh thuciamna ah na nasempa na tunpih hi. Ahih hangin kei sungah mawhna a om leh, nang mahmah in kei hong that in. Bang hangin na pa tungah ap kul ding ka hi hiam?” a ci hi.
Yahnathan in, “That ngei lo e! Ka pa in nang hong langpanna tawh a sia a gelna ka theih leh, nang hong gen loin om ding ka hi hiam?” a ci hi.
Tua ciangin David in Yahnathan kiangah, “Na pa in khauh takin nang hong dawng leh, kua in kei hong gen ding ahi hiam?” a ci hi.
Yahnathan in David kiangah, “Hong pai in, lo ah pai ni,” a ci hi. Tua ciangin a nihun a pai khawm uh hi.

Tua ciangin Yahnathan in David kiangah, “Israyl’ Pa, Yahweh in ka teci ahi hi. Thaiciang tu bang hunin ka pa ngaihsutna taktak ka na mukhia ding hi. Tua pen nang aa dingin a pha ahih leh, nang kiangah thu hong sawlin hong gensam lo ding ka hi hiam?

Ahih hangin ka pa in nang hong natsak ding a sawm ahi a, nang hong theisakin muanhuai takin nang kong khakkhiat kei leh, Yahweh in kei tungah a sia theithei-in hong bawl tahen. Yahweh in ka pa a ompih bangin nang hong ompih tahen.
Ahih hangin kei hong kithah loh nadingin ka nuntak sungin kei tungah Yahweh hong migit bang bek hi loin,
Yahweh in David galte leitung pan a khenkhiat ciang nangawnin ka innkuanpihte kiang panin na itna khenkhia kei in,” a ci hi.
Tua ahih manin Yahnathan in David innkuan tawh thuciamna khat bawlin, “David galte tungah Yahweh in thuk tahen,” a ci hi.
Yahnathan in ama pumpi a it bangin it ahih manin a kiciamna a kipsak thuah lai hi.
Tua ciangin Yahnathan in David kiangah, “Zingciangin Kha Det ni hi a, na tutna awng ding ahih manin nang hong kiphawk ding hi.
Tua lai-ah ni thum na om khit ciangin, manlang takin paisuk inla, hih buaina a kipat ni-in na kibukna ding mun ah omin, Ezel suangtum kiangah na om in.
Muitum bangin tua lampang ah thaltang thum ka lawn ding hi.

Tua lai-ah naupang khat ka sawl ding a, “Pai inla, thaltang va zong in,” a ci ding hi. Keimah in ama kiangah, “En in, thaltangte na gei hih lampang ah om hi, hiah hong paipih in,” ka cih leh, Yahweh nungta taktak ahih manin, nang aa dingin patauh ding omlo a, lauhuaina om lo hi.
Ahih hangin keimah in naupangpa kiangah, “En in thaltangte nang khen ah om ei,” ka cih leh, Yahweh in nang hong sawlkhia ahih manin pel loin na paikhia ding hi.
Phawk gige in, ei tegel i kikupna thu ah, nang leh kei kikalah i teci Yahweh hi tawntung hi,” a ci hi.
Tua ahih ciangin lo ah David kibu hi. Kha Det hong tun ciangin, pawi an ne dingin kumpipa a tu hi.
Kumpipa, kawm gei-a a tutna ngei tutna tungah a tu hi.Yahnathan dingto-in, Shaul’ gei-ah Abner tu a, ahih hangin David’ mun pen a awng hi.

Ahih hangin tua ni-in Shaul in bangmah gen lo hi; bang hang hiam cihleh amah in, “Neina bangin siang loh nadingin na khatpeuh David tungah piang hi ngelngel ding hi—amah siang lo taktak hi,” ci-in a ngaihsun hi.

Ahih hangin a zingciang, tua kha a ni nih ni-in David’ mun hawm leuleu hi. Tua ciangin Shaul in a tapa Yahnathan kiangah, “Zanni ahi a, tuni ahi zongin Yishai’ tapa in bang hangin an hong ne lo ahi hiam?” a ci hi.
Yahnathan in Shaul dawngin, “Bethlehem ah a pai theih nadingin David in kei kiangah phalna limtakin hong ngen hi.

Amah in, ‘Khuapi sungah ko beh in biakpiakna khat nei-in, ka sanggamte in tua lai-ah ka pai nadingin thu hong pia uh ahih manin hong paisak in. Tua ahih ciangin tu-in na mit ah maipha ka muh ahih leh, ka sanggamte tawh kimuh ding hong phal in,’ hong ci hi. Hih thu hangin kumpipa’ sabuai ah amah hong pai thei lo ahi hi,” a ci hi.

Tua ciangin Yahnathan tungah Shaul heh mahmah a, amah kiangah, “Nang a lehtat leh a lehdo numei’ tapa! Nang mahmah leh ta-a hong nei na nu maizum nadingin Yishai’ tapa a pawl na hih lam kithei lo na hi hiam?
Leitung ah tua Yishai’ tapa a nuntak lai teng nang na hi a, na kumpi-gam ahi zongin kip lo ding hi. Tu-in mi sawl inla kei kiangah amah hong paipih in; amah a sih kul taktak ding hi,” a ci hi.
Yahnathan in a pa Shaul dawngin, “Bang hangin amah kithat ding ahi hiam? Ama’n bang hih ahi hiam?” a ci hi.
Ahih hangin Shaul in a teipi tawh amah khawhin a that sawm hi; tua ahih manin a pa in David thah ding a khetsat lam Yahnathan in a thei hi.
Sabuai panin heh mahmahsa-in Yahnathan dingto hi. Tua kha a ni nih ni-in amah in an ne lo hi; bang hang hiam cihleh a pa in David tungah zumhuai takin a bawlna hangin amah a khasia hi.
David leh amah in a sehsa hun, zingsangin lo ah Yahnathan pai-in naupangno khat a tonpih hi.
Tua ciangin amah in naupangpa kiangah, “Ka lot ding thaltangte a zong dingin va tai in,” a ci hi. Naupang a tai laitakin ama khen ah a tu dingin thaltang khat a lawn hi.
Yahnathan in thaltang a lotna mun naupangpa a tun ciangin, Yahnathan in ama otsanin, “Nang’ khen ah thaltang om hi lo a hia?” a ci hi.
Tua ciangin Yahnathan in naupangpa kiangah, “Manlang in, kinawh in, zekai kei in!” ci-in a otsan hi. Tua ahih manin naupangpa in thaltangte kaikhawmin Yahnathan kiangah a paipihkik hi.
Ahih hangin naupangpa in bang thu piang hiam cih a thei kei hi. Yahnathan leh David bek in hih thu a thei uh hi.
Tua ciangin Yahnathan in naupangpa kiangah a galhiamte pia-in, ama kiangah, “Pai inla, khua sungah hihte na puakik in,” ci-in a hilh hi.

Naupangpa a paikhit phetin, David zong a kibukna mun panin leitaw lam ah paikhia a, Yahnathan mai-ah leilam nga-in thumvei a kunsuk hi. Tua khit ciangin kinamin kikah tuak uh a, ahih hangin David a nakkahzaw hi.

Tua ciangin Yahnathan in David kiangah, “Nuamtakin pai in; bang hang hiam cihleh eite Yahweh Min tawh i kiciam khin a, ‘Nang leh kei kikal, nang suanlekhakte leh kei suanlekhakte kikal ah Yahweh om tawntung hi,’ i ci hi,” a ci hi. Tua ciangin amah dingto-in paikhia a, khuapi ah Yahnathan a ciahkik hi.
Siampi Ahimelech omna Nob ah David pai hi. Ahimelech in David a muh ciangin lau mahmah a, “Bang hanga nang bek hong pai na hi hiam? Bang hangin kuamah hong tonpih lo na hi hiam?” a ci hi.

David in siampi Ahimelech kiangah, “Kumpipa in na khat hong sawlin, ‘Nang kong sawlna thu ahi a, nang kong thupiak peuhmah ahi zongin kuamah theisak kei in,’ hong cikhin hi. Mun khat ah ka mi tangvalte tawh kituah dingin ka genzo hi.
Tu lianin bang nei na hi hiam? Anlum nga ahih kei leh na muh peuhpeuh hong pia in,” a ci hi.
Siampipa in David dawngin, “Hih lai-ah neihkhop anlum ka nei kei a, ahih hangin a siangtho anlum pawlkhat a om hi; numeite kiang panin tangvalte a kikep nak uh leh la in,” a ci hi.

Tua ciangin David in siampipa dawngin, “A taktakin, kong dinkhiat uh a zan ni ma-in kote kiang panin numeite kikem uh hi. A siangtho lo a kisawl nasepnate nangawn ah mite’ pumpite a siangtho hi. Tua ahih manin tuni-in a siangtho nate tawh a kisai thu ah bangzah takin siang zaw kan ding ahi hiam,” a ci hi.

Tua ahih manin siampipa in a siangtho anlum a pia hi; bang hang hiam cihleh a kilakkhiat ni-a ompihna anlum thak a lumlai tawh kilaihin, Yahweh mai panin a kilakhia khin deuh ompihna anlum lui bek omin adang anlum omlo hi.
Tua ni-in Shaul nasemte khat tua lai-ah omin Yahweh mai-ah a khawlkhawl hi. Ama min pen Doeg hi a, Shaul tuucing makai Edom mi ahi hi.
David in Ahimelech kiangah, “Teipi ahi a, namsau ahi zongin tu lianin a om hia? Kumpipa nasepna kinawhlua ahih manin ka namsau ahi a, galhiam dang khatpeuh kong keng man kei hi,” a ci hi.

Siampipa in, “Elah Kuam-a na thah Philistia mi Goliath’ namsau hih lai-ah siampipuan nungah puan tawh kitunin om hi. Na deih leh la in. Ahih hangin hih lai-ah tua lo adang galhiam omlo hi,” ci-in a dawng hi. Tua ciangin David in, “Tua sang a hoihzaw omlo hi! Hong pia in!” a ci hi.
Tua ni-in Shaul mai panin David tai a, Gath kumpipa Achish kiangah a tung hi.
Achish’ uliante in ama kiangah, “David pen amau gama kumpi hi lo maw? A lamna ah ama thu lasakin, ‘Shaul in a tultul that, David in a thenthen that,’ ci-in sa uh hilo maw le?” a ci uh hi.
David in hih kammalte a lungsim ah ciamteh a, Gath kumpipa Achish a lau lua mahmah hi.
Tua ahih manin amaute muhna ah a omzia khelin, lungsim manpha lo a kineih hi. Kulh kongkhakte kui gawpin a khamul tungah a ciltui kaisakin mihai a kineih hi.
Tua ciangin Achish in a uliante kiangah, “En un, hih mipa a hai ahih lam na mu uh hi. Bang hangin kei kiangah hong paipih na hi uh hiam?
Kei omna mai hih lai-ah hih mihaipa nong paipih nadingun mihai kisam ka hi hiam? Hih mipa ka inn sung hong lut loh phamawh ahi hiam?” a ci hi.
David in tua lai nusia-in, Adullam kawhawm khat ah a suakta hi. A sanggam pasalte leh a pa’ innkuanpihte in tua thu a zak uh ciangin, amah tawh a kimu dingin a paisuk uh hi.
A lungkham mi khempeuh, leiba a nei mite leh a lungkim lo mite khempeuh ama kiangah hong kikhawm uh hi. Amah pen amaute tungah a ukpa a suak hi. Tua lai-ah amah tawh mi zali kiim a om hi.
Tua ciangin David in tua lai nusia-in Moab-a Mizpah ah pai-in amah in Moab kumpipa kiangah, “Yahweh in kei aa ding hong sepsakna ka theih dongin hih lai-ah ka nu leh ka pa hong omsak in,” a ci hi.
Tua ciang amah in Moab kumpipa kiangah amaute nusia-in, mun muanhuai sungah David a om hun sung khempeuh amah tawh amaute a om uh hi.
Tua ciangin kamsang Gad in David kiangah, “Mun muanhuai sungah om kei in. Hih lai nusia-in Yahdah gam ah pai in,” a ci hi. Tua ahih manin David pai-in Hereth-a gammang tulak ah a pai hi.
Tu-in Shaul in David leh a mite kimu hi, cih thu a ngah hi. Shaul in a khut sungah teipi tawi-in, a nasemte khempeuh a kiimkot ah dingin Gibeah gam Ramah-a makeng kung nuai-ah Shaul a tu hi.

Tua ciangin Shaul in a kiimkota ding uliante kiangah, “Benyamin mite aw, ngai un! Yishai’ tapa in note khatpeuh lote, leenggah lote hong pia ahi hiam, ahih kei leh a tultul ukte a zaza ukte-in note hong bawl ahi hiam?

Tua thu hangin note khempeuh in kei hong sawmsim na hi uh hiam? Ka tapa in Yishai’ tapa tawh thuciamna khat a bawl lam kuamah in nong pulak kei uh hi. Note khat beek in kei nong thudon kei uh a, ka tapa in tuni donga a gamtat bangin a buksim dingin kei langah ka nasempa a sawl na thu ah kuamah in nong gen kei uh a, nong thuum kei uh hi,” a ci hi.
Tua ciangin Shaul’ uliante tawh a ding khawm Edom mi Doeg in amah dawngin, “Nob-a Ahitub’ tapa Ahimelech kiangah Yishai tapa a pai ka mu hi.
Ahimelech in ama aa dingin Yahweh kiang thu dotsak a, amah in lam-an leh Philistia mi Goliath’ namsau pia hi,” a ci hi.
Tua ciangin kumpipa in Ahitub’ tapa siampi Ahimelech leh Nob-a siampi a sem a pa’ innkuanpih khempeuh samsak hi. Kumpipa mai-ah amaute khempeuh tung uh hi.
Shaul in, “Ahitub’ tapa aw, ngai in!” a ci hi. Tua ciangin amah in, “Hiah om ing, ka ukpa aw,” a ci hi.

Tua ciangin Shaul in ama kiangah, “Tuni-in amah bangin kei hong lehdo-in hong pansim nadingin anlum leh namsau pia-in, ama aa dingin Yahweh tungah thu dotsakna tawh bang hangin nang leh Yishai’ tapa in kei hong langpan sim na hi uh hiam?” ci-in a dong hi.
Ahimelech in kumpipa kiangah, “Na nasemte khempeuh lakah kumpipa’ makpa, na thupiakna bangin gamta-in na innkuan sungah a pahtawi huai David sangin a citakzaw kua om ahi hiam?

Ama aa dingin Yahweh kiangah thu ka dotsak tua ni a masa pen ahi hiam? Hi peuhmah lo hi! Na nasempa ahi a, a pa’ innkuan khatpeuh ahi zongin kumpipa aw hong mawhsak kei in; bang hang hiam cihleh kumpipa’ nasempa in hih thu tawmcik nangawn ahi a, tampi ahi zongin bangmah ka thei kei hi,” ci-in a dawng hi.
Ahih hangin kumpipa in, “Ahimelech, nang leh na pa’ innkuanpih khempeuh na si taktak ding hi,” a ci hi.

Tua ciangin kumpipa in a kiima om amah cingte thu pia-in, “Amaute in David pawlpih-in amah a tai lai-in amaute in thei a, tua thu kei kiangah hong puak lo uh ahih manin kihei unla Yahweh’ siampite that un,” a ci hi. Ahih hangin kumpipa’ uliante in Yahweh’ siampite a vat dingin a khutte uh liik lo uh hi.
Tua ciangin kumpipa in, Doeg thupia-in, “Nang kihei inla, siampite that in!” a ci hi. Tua ahih manin Edom mi Doeg kihei-in siampite vat a, tua ni-in siampi puan a silh mi 85 a that hi.
Amah in siampite khuapi Nob ah namsau liik hi. Numei pasal, naupang naungek, bawngtalte, laate leh tuute namsau hiam tawh a kithat hi.
Ahih hangin Ahitub’ ta Ahimelech, a tapa Abiathar suakta-in David pawlpih dingin a tai hi.
Shaul in Yahweh’ siampite a thahkhitna thu Abiathar in David a gen hi.

Tua ciangin David in Abiathar kiangah, “Tua lai ah Edom mi Doeg a om a, Shaul kiangah gen taktak ding hi cih tua ni-in ka thei mah hi. Keimah in mawhpuak ka nei-a, na pa inn-a mi khempeuh sihna ka piangsak kha hi.
Kei tawh hong om inla lau kei in. Kei nuntakna hong zongte, nang nuntakna zong hong zong ahi hi; ahih hangin kei tawh na om leh bangmah na ci kei ding hi,” a ci hi.
David kiangah, “En in, Philistia-te in Keilah sim uh a, a ancilna munte uh a luhsak uh hi,” ci-in a kikoh ciangin,
David in Yahweh dong a, “Keimah pai-in hih Philistia-te ka do ding hiam?” a ci hi. Tua ciangin Yahweh in David dawngin, “Pai in, Philistia-te do inla, Keilah hon in,” a ci hi.
Ahih hangin David’ mite in ama kiangah, “Hih Yahdah gam ah eite i lau hi. Philistia galkapte sim dingin Keilah ah kuan le hang bangzah takin lauhuaizaw kan ding ahi hiam?” a ci hi.
Tua ahih manin David in Yahweh kiang khat vei dong kik hi. Yahweh in amah dawngin, “Ding inla, Keilah ah paisuk in; bang hang hiam cihleh na vangliatna sungah Philistia-te kong pia ding hi,” a ci hi.

Tua ciangin Keilah ah David leh a mite pai uh a, Philistia-te tawh a kilai uh hi. Amaute in Philistia-te supna lianpi thuaksak uh a, a ganhonte laksak uh hi. Tua hi a, David in Keilah-a tengte a hon hi.
(David kiangah Ahimelech’ tapa Abiathar a tai lai-in amah in siampi puan a kengsuk hi.)

Keilah ah David a pai lam Shaul kiangah thu kipuak a, Shaul in, “Yahweh in ka vangliatna sungah amah hong piakhin hi; bang hang hiam cihleh kulhkongpi leh a kalhna a nei khuapi ah lutna tawh amah le amah thang kisiah ahi hi,” a ci hi.
Tua ciangin Shaul in, “Keilah ah paisukin David leh a mite umcih dingin a mite khempeuh khawmin a sam hi.
Shaul in amah a sawmsim lam David in a theih ciangin, amah in siampi Abiathar kiangah, “Siampi puan hong paipih in,” a ci hi.
Tua ciangin David in, “Israyl’ Pa, Yahweh aw, keima hangin Keilah susia dingin Shaul hong pai ding thu na nasempa in ka zakhin taktak hi.

Keilah-a mite in ama thahatna ah kei hong pia ding uh hiam? Na nasempa’ zaksa bangin Shaul hong paisuk ding hiam? Israyl’ Pa, Yahweh aw, kong thuum hi, na nasempa kiang hong gen in,” a ci hi. Tua ciangin Yahweh in, “Hong pai ding hi,” a ci hi.
Tua ciangin David in, “Keilah-a mite in Shaul vangliatna sungah kei leh ka mite hong pia ding uh hiam?” ci-in a dong hi. Tua ciangin Yahweh in, “Amaute hong pia ding uh hi,” a ci hi.

Tua ahih manin David leh zaguk bang a pha a mite dingto-in Keilah nusia uh a, mun khat khit mun khat a kikhin uh hi. Keilah panin David a taikhit na thu Shaul kiangah a kizaksak ciangin, tua lai ah amah pai nawn lo hi.
Sehnel-gam mun muanhuaite leh Ziph Sehnel-gam mualkuamte ah David a om hi. Shaul in nisimin David a zon hangin, Yahweh in Shaul’ khut sungah David a pia kei hi.
Ziph Sehnel-gam sung Horesh ah David a om laitakin, a nuntakna la dingin Shaul a kuankhiat lam David in a theikha hi.
Tua ciangin Horesh-a David kiangah Shaul’ tapa Yahnathan pai-in, Yahweh sungah tha a lak nadingin a hanthawn hi.

Amah in David kiangah, “Lau peuhmah kei in; bang hang hiam cihleh ka pa Shaul’ khut in nang hong sukha lo ding hi. Nang pen Israyl’ tungah kumpi na hi ding a, nang zom ah kei ka hi ding hi. Ka pa Shaul nangawn in hih thu thei hi,” a ci hi.
Tua ahih manin amau tegel in Yahweh mai-ah thuciamna khat a bawl uh hi. Horesh ah David omlai-in Yahnathan a inn ah a ciah hi.
Tua ciangin Gibeah ah Ziph mite in Shaul neh-in, “Yeshimon leitaw lam Hakilah mualtung Horesh-a mun muanhuai sung kote lakah David kibu hilo ahi hiam?
Tu-in kumpipa aw, nong paisuk nop peuhpeuh ciangin hong paisuk inla, kumpipa tungah kong piakna tawh ko sep ding ka sem ding uh hi,” a ci uh hi.
Tua ciangin Shaul in, “Yahweh in note thupha hong pia tahen; bang hang hiam cihleh note in kei tungah hehpihna nong nei uh hi.
Pai unla, va kithawi beh lai un. David’ bukna koi lai hiam cih va theikhia unla, a mu kua hiam hong thei un; bang hang hiam cihleh amah ngiansiam mahmah hi, ci-in kei tungah hong kigen hi.

Bukna-in a zat mun khempeuh va thei khia unla, thu kician taktak tawh kei kiangah thu hong puakkik un. Tua ciangin no tawh kong pai ding hi. Tua kual ah amah a om leh Yahdah beh sung khempeuh ah ka zong ding hi,” a ci hi.
Tua ahih ciangin amaute dingkhia-in Shaul pai ma-in Ziph ah pai uh hi. Yeshimon leitaw lam Arabah sunga om Maon Sehnel-gam ah David leh a mite om uh hi.

Shaul leh a mite a zong ding a kipat uh ciangin, David kiangah thu kipuak hi. Tua ciangin suangpi ah paisukin Maon Sehnel-gam sungah a om hi. Shaul in hih thu a zak ciangin, Maon Sehnel-gam ah David nungdelh hi.
David leh a mite in mual pang langkhat a zuih laitakin tua mual pang a langkhat ah Shaul a pai hi. Shaul leh a mite in amaute man dingin hong neh semsem uh ahih manin Shaul a pelhkhia mengmeng uh hi.
Ahih hangin tua hun pawlin Shaul kiangah kamtai khat hong tungin, “Hong pai mengmeng in, Philistia-te in i gam hong sim uh hi,” a ci hi.
Hih thu hangin Shaul in David nungdelhna pan tawpin Philistia-te a do dingin a kuan hi. Tua thu hangin amaute in hih mun Sela Hammahlekoth; Suahtakna Suangpi, a ci uh hi.
Tua ciangin tua lai panin David paito-in En Gedi-a mun muanhuaite ah a teng hi.
Philistia-te delhna pan Shaul a ciahkik khit ciangin, ama kiangah, “En Gedi Sehnel gam ah David om hi,” ci-in kigen hi.
Tua ciangin Shaul in Israyl khempeuh panin a kitengkhia mi 3,000 samin, Sathak Kenpi kianga om David leh a mite zong dingin a kuan uh hi.
Lampi dunga tuu-khawkte ah amah tungin, tua lai-ah kawhawm khat om ahih manin a tawlnga dingin tua sungah Shaul a pai hi. (David leh a mite, tua suanghawm tawng pekah a om uh hi.)

Tua ciangin David’ mite in ama kiangah, “Yahweh in nang kiangah, ‘Na galpa na ut bangbanga na bawl theih nadingin na khut vangliatna sungah kong pia ding hi,’ a cih ni tuni teekteek ahi hi,” a ci uh hi. Tua ciangin David awmtal khiankhianin, Shaul’ puantualpi mong khat a atkhiatsak hi.
Ahih hangin amah in Shaul’ puanmong a tankhiatsakna hangin David a kisuangtaak mahmah hi.

Tua ciangin amah in a mite kiangah, “Amah Yahweh’ sathau nilhsa ahih manin Yahweh’ sathau nilhsa ka ukpa thatin ahih keileh ama tungah ka khut liikin tua bangin gamtat ding Yahweh hong khaam hi,” a ci hi.
Hih kammalte tawh David in a mite khaamin, amaute in Shaul a do ding uh David in phal lo hi. Tua ciangin kawhawm panin Shaul paikhia-in, a pai nading ah a pai hi.
Tua ciangin kawhawm panin David paikhia-in, “Kei hong uk kumpipa aw!” ci-in Shaul a sam hi. Shaul in a nunghei ciangin David in lei ah a mai kunin zahtakna a pia hi.
Tua khit ciangin David in Shaul kiangah, “Mite in nang kiangah, ‘Na siatna ding David in zong taktak hi,’ a cihna thu bang hangin um na hi hiam?

En in, Yahweh in ka vangliatna sungah nang hong piak khitna thu tuni-in na mit mahmah tawh na mukhin a, pawlkhat in nang thah dingin hong kun uh hi. Ahih hangin nang kong khah a, ‘Ka ukpipa tungah ka khut ka liik kei ding hi; bang hang hiam cihleh amah pen Yahweh’ sathau nilhsa ahi hi,” a ci hi.

En in, ka pa aw! Ka khut sunga na puanmong en in! Keimah in na puanmong bek ka atkhia a, ahih hangin nang kong that kei hi; sepkhialhna ahi a, lehdona hang ahi zongin ka khialh lohna leh nang tungah ka mawh lohna hong tel inla hong mu in. Tua hi napi-in ka nuntakna la dingin nangmah in kei nong beng hi.
Nang leh kei kikalah Yahweh in thu hong khen henla, Yahweh in nang tungah ka phu hong laksak tahen! Ahih hangin nang tungah keima khut mahmah ka khial kei ding hi.
Khangluite in, “A gilote kiang mah panin gitlohna hong pai,” ci-in paunak a om hi. Tua ahih manin keima khut mahmah in nang hong su lo ding hi.
Kua langpangin Israyl kumpipa hong kuan khia na hi hiam? Kua delh na hi hiam? Ui sisa khat hiam? Uili khat hiam?
Thukhenpa Yahweh hi henla, nang leh kei kikal ah Amah in thu hong khen hen. Ka thu hong ngaihsutsak henla, hong lenkip hen; na khut panin Ama’n hong honkhia tahen,” a ci hi.
David in hih thute Shaul kiangah a gen khit ciangin, Shaul in, “Ka tapa David aw, hih nang aw ahi hiam?” a ci hi. Tua ciangin amah a nakpi-in a kap hi.
Tua khit ciangin amah in David kiangah, “Kei sangin nang na thumaan zaw hi; bang hang hiam cihleh siatna tawh nang kong bawl hangin dikna tawh kei nong thuk hi.
Kei tungah a hoih nong bawlna tu-in nong gen khin hi; Yahweh in na vangliatna ah kei hong piak hangin nangmah in kei nong that kei hi.
Mi khat in a galpa a muh ciangin, nasak loin khahkong ding ahi hiam? Tuni-a kei tungah nong bawlna hangin Yahweh in a hoih tawh nang thaman hong pia tahen.
Tu-in kumpi na suah taktak ding thu leh nangma khut sungah Israyl’ kumpi-gam a kikipsak ding thu ka thei taktak hi.
Ka suanlekhakte na beisak loh ding leh ka pa’ innkuan panin ka min na phiat loh nadingin Yahweh min tawh kei tungah hong kiciam in,” a ci hi.
Tua ahih manin Shaul tungah David a kiciam hi. Tua ciangin Shaul inn ah ciahkik a, ahih hangin David leh a mite mun muanhuai ah a paikik uh hi.
Tu-in Samuyl si ta a, Israyl khempeuh kikaikhawmin, amah kah uh a, Ramah a, a inn ah a vui uh hi. Tua ciangin Paran Sehnel gam sungah David a paisuk hi.
Carmel ah neihsa a nei Maon-a teng mipa khat in neihsa a hau mahmah hi. Amah in keel tulkhat leh tuu tulthum nei a, tuate Carmel ah a mul a met hi.
Tua mipa min pen Nabal hi a, a zi’ min Abigail ahi hi. Tua numei tei leh melhoih a thuah khat hi a, ahih hangin a pasal pen a lungtom mi leh a gilo khat hi a, amah Caleb mi ahi hi.
Sehnel-gam ah David a om laitakin, Nabal in a tuumul a metna thu a za hi.
Tua ahih manin amah in tangval sawm sawlin, “Carmel ah paito-in Nabal kiangah pai unla, keima min tawh va hopih un.

Hih bangin ama kiangah na gen ding uh hi, ‘L’Chai (Na khan sawt tahen)! Nang leh na innkuante tungah Shalom (Nang leh na innkuante tungah nopna hong tung tahen)! Na neih khempeuh tungah Shalom (Na neih khempeuh nopna om tahen)!
Tu-in tuumul met hun hi ta hi, ci-in ka za hi. Na tuucingte uh ko kiangah hong om sungun amaute bawlsia loin Carmel a, a om sungteng uh bangmah a mangsak kei uh hi.

Na tangvalte kiang mahmah ah dong in, amaute in hong gen ding uh hi. Tua ahih manin pawi huna hong pai ka hih buangun nangma mit ah ka tangvalte na maipha na musak in. Na muh peuhpeuh na nasemte tung leh na tapa David tungah hong pia in,’ ci un,” a ci hi.
David’ tangvalte a tun uh ciangin, amaute in David’ min tawh Nabal kiangah thu puak uh a, a dawnkik ding a ngak uh hi.
Tua ciangin Nabal in David’ kamtaite kiangah, “David kua hi peuhmah ahi hiam? Yishai’ tapa kua ahi hiam? Tu hunin a pute kiang pana tai nasem tampi om hi.
Koi lai panin hong pai cih ka theih loh mite tungah bang hangin ka anlumte, tuite leh ka ganmul mette aa dingin ka gawhsate pia ding ka hi hiam?” ci-in a dawng hi.
Tua ahih manin David’ tangvalte a khetul lam uh ah kihei-in paikhia uh hi. Amaute ciahkikin ama kiangah thu khempeuh a gen uh hi.

Tua ciangin David in a mite thu pia-in, “Na namsaute kuah un!” a ci hi. Tua ahih manin David leh mi khempeuh in a namsau ciat kuah uh hi. David tawh mi zali kiim kuankhawmin zanih in a vante uh a ngak uh hi.
A tangvalte khat in hih thu Nabal’ zi Abigail kiangah thu puakin, “David in sehnel-gam panin kamtai hong sawlin, ka ukpa uh hopihsak a, ahih hangin amah in amaute na zahko hi.
Tua hi napi hih mite ko tungah hong migi uh hi. Amaute kiang lo sungah ka om sung tawntung uh hong bawlsia loin zong hong nasak lo uh a, bangmah zong ka mansuah kei uh hi.
Amaute kiang ka gante uh ka cin sung tawntung sun hitaleh zan hitaleh kote aa dingin ka kulh bang ahi uh hi.

Tu-in hih dinmun thei inla, bang hih ding na hiam cih ngaihsun in. Ka ukpa leh a innkuanpih khempeuh tungah tuahsiatna a tung ding hi ta hi; bang hang hiam cihleh amah pen Belial’ tapa khat bang hi a, kuamah hopih theih loh ahi hi,” a ci hi.
Tua ciangin Abigail in manlang takin anlum zanih, leenggahzu savun thawl nih, tuu semsa nga, an kansa seah nga, leenggahkeu beu zakhat leh theigah-ho beu zanih laate tungah a suanto hi.
Tua ciangin tuanu in a nasemte thupia-in, “Ka mai-ah pai un; note nungah kong pai ding hi,” a ci hi. Ahih hangin amah in a pasal zasak lo hi.
Amah laa tung tuangin mualkawm ah a pai laitakin David leh a mite ama lam manawhin tuaksuk uh a, amah in amaute na dawn hi.
David in, “Hih mipa neihsa sehnel gam ah khat beek a pelhem loh nadingin ka vilsakna khempeuh a mawkna suak hi. Amah in diktatna pen siatna tawh hong thuk hi.
Zingsang ciangin amah tawh kisai khempeuh pasal khat zong ka siit tak leh Yahweh in David’ galte tungah a ututin hih henla, tua sang a nasiazaw-in zong behlap tahen!” a ci khin phet ahi hi.
Abigail in David a muh ciangin, a laa tung panin manlang takin kumkhia-a, David mai-ah maikunin a boksuk hi.
A khephung ah tuanu kunsukin, “Ka ukpa aw, hih mawhsakna kei tung bek ah hong tusak in. Nangma zakin na nasemnu thugen ding hong phal inla, na nasemnu kammalte hong ngaihsak in.
Ka ukpa aw hih Belial’ tapa banglel Nabal thudonin nei kei in. Ama min Nabal; mihai, hi a, haina tawh kidim hi. Ahih hangin na nasemnu keimah in nangma nong sawl tangvalte ka mu kha kei hi.

Tu-in ka ukpa aw, Yahweh nungta-in nang zong na nuntak mah bangin, sisan luangsak dingin paina pan leh nangma khut mahmah tawh phulakna panin Yahweh in nang hong kho ahih nungsang, na galte leh nang hong nasak nuamte Nabal tawh kibang tahen.
Na nasemnu in ka ukpa tunga kong puak hih letsong, nang hong zui mite tungah hong piasak in.

Hih na nasemnu gamtat khialhna hong maisak in; bang hang hiam cihleh ka ukpa in Yahweh’ galte do na hih manin Yahweh in ka ukpa aa dingin a kip tawntung inn khat hong lamsak taktak ding hi. Na nuntak sung tawntung nang sungah siatna kimu kei tahen!
Mi khat in hong delhin hong thah sawm phial hangin, Yahweh na Pa in a nungtate a kepna sungah ka ukpa’ nuntakna hong kem tahen. Suanglotna panin lotkhiat bangin na galte nuntakna kilawnkhia tahen.
Nang tawh kisai-in Yahweh in hong ciamsa na hoih khempeuh ka ukpa aa dingin hong bawlsakin, Israyl-te ukpa-in hong sehkhit ciangin,

thu om lopi-in sisan luansakna ahi a, nang mahmah in phu na lak lohna ahi zongin ka ukpa aa dingin lungkim lohna leh vangik a suak kei ding hi. Ahih hangin Yahweh in ka ukpa limtakin hong bawl ciangin, na nasemnu hong phawk in,” a ci hi.
Tua ciangin David in Abigail kiangah, “Tuni-in kei hong dawn dingin nang hong sawl Israyl’ Pa, Yahweh kiphat tahen!
Sisan suahna pan leh keima khut tawh phu lak nading panin hong kem na hih manin thupha ngah ta inla, a pilvang na ngaihsutna in thupha ngah tahen.

Nang natsak nading panin kei hong kem Israyl’ Pa, Yahweh a nungta taktak ahih mah bangin manlang takin hong pai-in hong dawn lo hi lecin, zingsang nisuah ciangin Nabal’ mi pasal khat zong a nungta-in ka siit kei ding hi,” a ci hi.
Tua ahih ciangin tuanu in ama kiangah a paipihte David in sangin, tuanu kiangah, “Na inn ah nuamtakin pai in. Na thute ka zakhin a, nong ngetna kong pia khin hi,” a ci hi.

Tua ciangin Nabal kiangah Abigail pai-in ahih hangin a inn sungah kumpipa khatpeuh pawi bangin pawi bawlin a na omna a mu hi. Nabal in zu kham lua ahih manin lungnuam mahmah hi. Tua ahih manin tuanu in ama kiangah bangmah gen lo a, zingsang khuavak dong tawmcik ahi a, tampi ahi zongin gen lo hi.
Zingsang ciang, Nabal’ leenggahzu khamna a ven ciangin a zi in hih thute khempeuh a gen hi. Tua ciangin a lungtang khawlin, suangtum khat bangin amah a om hi.
Ni sawm khit khawng ciangin Yahweh in Nabal vatin amah si hi.

Nabal sihna David in a zak ciangin, amah in, “Nabal khut tung panin ka ngah zahkona hong thuksakin, gamtat khialhna panin a nasempa hong kem Yahweh in phatna ngah tahen! Yahweh in Nabal’ gamtat khialhna ama lutung mah ah heikik hi,” a ci hi. Tua ciangin David in Abigail kiangah thu puakin, a zi dingin a dongsak hi.
Carmel ah David’ kamtaite a tun uh ciangin amaute in Abigail kiangah, “David in nang ama zi dingin a dong dingin nangma kiangah kote hong sawl hi,” a ci uh hi.
Tua ciangin tuanu dingto-in leilak lam ah a mai kunsukin, “Hih lai-ah na nasemnu uh note nasem ding leh ka ukpa’ nasemte khe a silsak dingin a kithawisa-in ka om hi,” a ci hi.
Laa khat tungah Abigail tuang pahin, a nasem numei ngate in kem a, tuanu in David’ kamtaite zui-in ama zi a suak hi.
David in Yezreel-a Ahinoam zong tenpih a, tua ahih manin amau tegel a zi ahi uh hi.
Ahih hangin Shaul in David’ zi a tanu Michal, Gallam pana Laish’ tapa Paltiel tungah a pia hi.
Gibeah-a om Shaul kiangah Ziph mite pai uh a, “Yeshimon gal-a Hachilah mualtung ah David bu hi,” a ci uh hi.
Tua ahih manin a kitengkhia Israyl mi tulthum tawh Ziph Sehnel gam sungah David zong dingin Ziph Sehnel-gam ah Shaul paisuk hi.
Shaul in Yeshimon maingatin Hakilah mualtung-a lampi gei ah giahphual sat a, ahih hangin sehnel gam ah David a om hi. Tua lai-ah Shaul in amah a sulzuih lam a theih ciangin,
amah in thukansimte sawlkhia a, Nacon ah Shaul a tun khit lam ciantakin a thei hi.

Tua ciangin David dingkhia-in Shaul in giahphual a satna mun ah pai hi. David in Shaul leh Ner’ tapa a galkap mangpa Abner lupna mun a mu hi. Giahphual sunglam ah Shaul lum a, galkapte in a kiimkot ah giahphual sat uh hi.

Tua ciangin David in Hit mi Ahimelech leh Yahab’ sanggampa Zeruyah’ tapa Abishai kiangah, “Giahphual sunga Shaul kiangah kuan hong zui ding na hi uh hiam?” ci-in a dong hi. Abishai in, “Nang kong zui ding hi,” a ci hi.
Tua ahih manin galkapte omna ah zanin David leh Abishai pai uh a, tua lai giahbuk sunga a lukhung leilak ah teipi phutsa-in Shaul a ihmu hi. Ama kiimkot ah Abner leh mite a lum uh hi.
Abishai in David kiangah, “Tuni-in na khut sungah Yahweh in na galpa hong piazo hi. Teipi tawh khatvei sunin lei tawh hong suncipsak in. A nihveina sutkik kul nawn lo ding hi!
Ahih hangin David in Abishai kiangah, “Amah susia kei in! Yahweh’ sathau nilhsa khat tungah khut khialin a mawh lo kua om ahi hiam?” a ci hi.
David in gen beh lai-in, “Yahweh a nungta taktak ahih manin Yahweh mahmah in amah vat ding hi; a sih hun hong tung ding a, ahih keileh galsim dingin amah kuanin kithat ding hi.
Ahih hangin Yahweh’ sathau nilhsa khat tungah ka khut khialh ding Yahweh in hong khaam hi. Tu-in a lukhunga teipi leh tuithawl la inla, pai ni,” a ci hi.

Tua ahih manin David in Shaul’ lukhunga teipi leh tuithawl la-in a paikhia hi. Tua banga a hih uh a mu ahi a, a thei ahi zongin khat beek omlo a, a phawk zong khat beek a om kei hi. Amaute khempeuh i mu kim uh hi; bang hang hiam cihleh Yahweh kiang panin ihmut sipna amaute tungah tung hi.
Tua ciangin mual pang langkhat ah David galkahin, a kigamla simsim mual dawn khat ah a ding hi; amaute kikal ah mun zapi khat in a hal hi.
David in mite leh Ner’ tapa Abner otsanin, “Abner aw, kei nong dawng ding hiam?” a ci hi. Tua ciangin Abner dawngin, “Kumpipa a sam nang kua na hi hiam?” a ci hi.

David in Abner kiangah, “Nang pasal khat na hi hi, himah lo na hi hiam? Israyl sung khempeuh ah nang tawh a kibang kua om ahi hiam? Tua hi napi-in bang hangin na uk kumpipa cing lo na hi hiam? Na ukpa ahi kumpipa susia dingin mi khat hong pai hi!

Tua bang na gamtatna hoih het lo hi. Yahweh a nungta ahih mah bangin a si dingin na kilawm hi; bang hang hiam cihleh Yahweh’ sathau nilhsa na ukpa na cing kei hi. Tu-in a lukhunga kumpipa’ teipi leh a tuithawl koi ah om hiam, na mu uh hia?” a ci hi.
Tua ciangin Shaul in David’ aw ahih lam thei a, “Ka tapa David aw, nangma aw ahi hiam?” a ci hi. Tua ciangin David in, “Kei hong uk kumpipa aw, keima aw hi,” a ci hi.
Amah in zomto lai-in, “Hih bangin na nasempa hong delh na hi hiam? Ke’n bang hih ka hi hiam? Ka khut sungah bang siatna om ahi hiam?

Tu-in kei hong uk kumpipa aw na nasempa’ kammalte na ngai in. Yahweh in kei langa pang dingin nang hong kun ahileh biakna hong sang hen. Ahi zongin mihing sep ahih leh amaute in Yahweh mai-ah hamsiatna thuak uh hen! Tu-in Yahweh’ gamluah sunga keimah sehtanh panin amaute in kei hong notkhia uh a, ‘Pai inla Pasian (Elohim)’ nasem in,’ hong ci uh hi.
Yahweh’ maitang omna panin a gamla leitung ah ka sisan hong taksak kei in. Mualtung ah vaka a beng khat bangin uili a bang lel khat zong dingin Israyl kumpipa nong kuankhia hi,” a ci hi.

Tua ciangin Shaul in, “Ka mawhzo hi. Ka tapa David aw hong paikik in. Nang kong nasak nawn kei ding hi; bang hang hiam cihleh tuni-in na mit ah ka nuntakna manpha na sa hi. A taktakin mihai bangin ka gamta a ka khial mahmah hi,” a ci hi.
Tua ciangin David dawngin, “Hih lai-ah kumpipa’ teipi om hi. Na tangvalte khat hong paisak inla hong lasak in.
Yahweh in mi khat peuhpeuh ama thumaanna leh a cihtakna thaman pia tahen! Tuni-in ka vangliatna sungah Yahweh in nang hong pia a, ahih hangin Yahweh’ sathau nilhsa khat tungah ka khut khial kei hi.
A taktakin ka mit ah na nuntakna man nei kasak mah bangin Yahweh’ mit ah ka nuntakna man nei hong sa henla, Amah in lungkhamna khempeuh panin hong honkhia tahen!” a ci hi.

Tua ciangin Shaul in David kiangah, “Ka tapa David aw, thupha ngah in! Na lianpi na sem ding a, na gualzo taktak ding hi,” a ci hi. Tua ahih manin David a pai nading ah pai-in Shaul a inn ah a ciahkik hi.

Ahih hangin David in a lungsim sungah, “Ni khat ni ciangin Shaul khutlumin ka si kha thei ding hi. Philistia-te gam ah tai ding lo buang kei aa dingin a hoihzaw om lo hi. Tua hileh Israyl gam mun khatpeuh ah Shaul in hong zon niloh lungkia ding a, hi bangin ama khut panin ka suakta ding hi,” ci-in a ngaihsun hi.
Tua ciangin David leh amah tawh a om mi zagukte paikhia uh a, Gath kumpipa Maoch’ tapa Achish kiangah a tung uh hi.
Gath ah Achish tawh David teng khawm uh hi. A mite amau innkuan ciat tawh tengin, David in a zi nihte Yezreel-a Ahinoam leh Nabal’ zi meigongnu, Carmel-a Abigail-te a nei hi.
Gath ah David a taina thu Shaul kiangah a kizaksak ciangin, amah in David a zong nawn kei hi.

Tua ciangin David in Achish kiangah, “Nangma mit ah maipha ka ngah ahih leh, na gam sungah ka ten theih nadingin na gama khuapi khatpeuh ah mun khat hong pia in. Bang hangin nangmah tawh na nasempa kumpi inn sungah teng khawm ding ka hi hiam?” a ci hi.
Tua ahih manin tua ni-in Achish in ama tungah Ziklag pia a, tua-a kipan Yahdah kumpite neih ahi den hi.
Philistia-te gam sungah David a om hun sung pen kum khat leh kha li bit ahi hi.
Tua ciangin David leh a mite pai-in Geshur mite, Girz mite leh Amalak mite a buluh uh hi. (Tanglai pek panin hih mite Shur leh Egypt gam dongah a teng uh hi.)
David in gamhuam khat a sim peuhpeuh ciangin numei ahi a, pasal ahi zongin hingkhawi lo a, ahih hangin amah in tuute, bawngte, laate, kalaohte leh puansilhte la-in Achish ah a ciahkik hi.

Achish in ama kiangah, “Tuni-in koi lai buluh ding na hi hiam?” ci-in a dong hi. Tua ciangin David in, “Yahdah leitaw lam gamhuam ahih keileh Yerahmeel mite leitaw lam gamhuam ahih keileh Ken mite leitaw lam gamhuam hin teh,” ci-in a dawng hi.

Gath ah thu piang a puak dingin David in numei ahi a, pasal ahi zongin nungtasak lo hi. David in, “Tua bang hi kei leh amaute in eite’ thu puakin, ‘David in hih bangin hih hi,’ ci ding uh hi,” a ci hi. Philistia-te gam sungah a om sung tawntungin amah in hih bangin a hih hi.

Tua ahih manin David in ama tunga a gen bangin Achish in umin, amah in a lungsim sungah, “A mipih Israyl-te in amah a muhdah taktak dingin gamta khin hi. Tua ahih ciangin amah pen ka nasem hi tawntung ding hi!” ci-in a ngaihsun hi.
Tua hun laitakin Philistia-te in Israyl do dingin a galkapte uh a kaikhawm uh hi. Tua ciangin Achish in David kiangah, “Nang leh na mite in kei tawh gal nong kuankhop ding lam thei in,” a ci hi.

David in Achish dawngin, “Na nasempa in bang hih thei hiam, cih na thei taktak ding hi,” a ci hi. tua ciangin Achish in David kiangah, “Hih thu hangin kei hong cing a lianpente khatin kong koih tawntung ding hi,” a ci hi.
Tu-in Samuyl sita a, ama hangin Israyl khempeuh kapin, Ramah-a ama khuapi ah a vui uh hi. Tua ciangin Shaul in misi thu dongte leh aitawite a gam panin a hawlkhia khin hi.
Tua ciangin Philistia-te kikhawmin kuanto uh a, Shunem ah giahphual a sat uh hi. Tua ahih manin Shaul in Israyl khempeuh khawmin, Gilboa ah giahphual a sat uh hi.
Shaul in Philistia galkapte a muh ciangin amah lau-in a lungsim lauluatna tawh kidim hi.
Shaul in Yahweh thu a dot ciangin, mangmatnate tungtawnin ahi a, Urim tungtawnin ahi a, kamsangte tungtawnin ahi zongin Yahweh in amah dawng lo hi.
Tua ciangin Shaul in a nasemte kiangah, “Ama kiangah pai-in thu ka dot theih nadingin vankah numei khat hong zonsak un,” a ci hi. A nasemte in, “En Dor ah vankah numei khat om hi,” a ci uh hi.

Tua ahih ciangin Shaul in a mel seelin puan dang silh a, pasal nih tawh a pai hi. Zanin tua numei kiangah a tung uh hi. Amah in tuanu kiangah, “Kei aa dingin kha khat hong dotsak inla, a min ka gen pen hong saptohsak in,” a ci hi.

Tua ciangin numei in ama kiangah, “Shaul in a hihsa thu na thei hi; amah in gam sung panin vankah-te leh aitawite a not khiazo hi.Tua hi a, bang hangin ka sih theih nadingin ka nuntakna thang hong siah na hi hiam?” a ci hi.
Tuanu tungah Yahweh Min tawh Shaul kiciam a, “Yahweh a nungta ahih mah bangin hih thu hangin nang tungah dantatna hong tung lo ding hi,” a ci hi.
Tua ciangin numei in, “Nang aa dingin kua hong saptohsak ding ka hi hiam?” a ci hi. Tua ciangin amah in, “Samuyl hong sapsak in,” a ci hi.
Numei in Samuyl a muh ciangin, amah kapkhia beba a, numei in Shaul kiangah, “Bang hangin hong khem na hi hiam? Nang Shaul na hi hi!” a ci hi.
Kumpipa in tuanu kiangah, “Lau kei in. Bang mu na hi hiam?” a ci hi. Tua ciangin numei in Shaul kiangah, “Leilak panin a pusuakkhia pasian (el) kha khat ka mu hi,” a ci hi.

Tua ahih manin amah in tuanu kiangah, “Bang tawh kibang ahi hiam?” ci-in a dong hi. Tuanu in, “Putek khat hong paito-in, puantualpi tawh kituam hi,” a ci hi. Tua ciangin Shaul in Samuyl hi, ci-in ngaihsunin, lei lam ah a mai kunin zahtakna a pia hi.

Samuyl’ meelpuapa in, “Kei saptohna tawh bang hangin hong nawngkaisak na hi hiam?” a ci hi. Shaul in, “Ka lung himawh lua mahmah hi. Philistia-te in kei hong do sawmin, Yahweh in kei hong taisan ta a, mangmatnate tungtawn ahi a, kamsangte tungtawn ahi zongin kei hong dawng nawn lo hi. Tua thu hangin nang hong sam ka hi a, ka sep dingzia nong gen theikha ding hi,” a ci hi.
Tua ciangin Samuyl’ meelpuapa in, “Nang kiang panin Yahweh kihei-in na galpa a suahkhit nungsang bang hangin kei hong kuppih na hi hiam?
Yahweh in kei tungtawnin a genkholhsa bangin hih khin hi: nangma khut panin Yahweh in kumpi-gam balkhia khin a, na sanggampa David tungah pia khin hi.
Bang hang hiam cihleh nangmah in Yahweh’ thu mang loin, Amalek mite tungah ama thangpaihna tawh kizui-in sem lo na hih manin tuni-in Yahweh in hih bangin hong bawl ahi hi.

Yahweh in Philistia-te tungah nang leh Israyl hong pia khawm ding a, zingciangin nang leh na tapate kei tawh om khawm ding hi. Philistia-te khut sungah Yahweh in Israyl galkapte pia ding hi,” a ci hi.
Samuyl’ meelpuapa kammalte hangin lauluatna tawh kidimin thakhatin leilak ah Shaul tawnpuk pah hi. Amah in sun tawntung zan tawntung an ne lo ahih manin a tha teng bei hi.
Numei hong pai-in Samuyl’ kammalte hangin Shaul nakpi takin a lauthawngna a muh ciangin amah in, “En in, Na nasemnu in na thu kong mang khin hi. Ka nuntakna khamin, nang sawl bangin ka hih hi.
Tu-in na nasemnu aw hong ngai in, na mai-ah an tawm khat hong luisak in; na pai nading ah na pai ma-in tha thak na ngah nadingin ne in,” a ci hi.
Ahih hangin ama’n nialin, “Ka ne kei ding hi,” a ci hi. Ahih hangin a nasemte leh numeinu in a nek nadingin kun uh ahih manin amaute thu a mang hi. Tua ciangin leilak panin amah thoto-in a tu hi.
Numeinu in a inn ah bawngno thau khat nei ahih manin manlang takin a go hi. Tua khit ciangin amah in annel la a, a annel mekin silngo sawh loh anlum a em hi.
Shaul leh a nasemte kiangah paipihin, amaute in ne uh hi. Tua khit ciangin tua zanin amaute a paikhia uh hi.

headings.text: Achish in Ziklag ah David Sawlkik

verses.text: Philistia-te in Aphek ah a galkapte khempeuh khawm uh a, Israyl mite in Yezreel-a tuinak kiangah giahphual sat uh hi.
Philistia gam-ukte a zaza a tultulin kuan uh a, David leh a mite zong Achish tawh a nungah pai uh hi.

Tua ciangin Philistia makaipite in, “Hih Hebrew-te in ei tawh bang hong hih uh ahi hiam?” a ci uh hi. Achish in Philistia makaipite kiangah, “Hih pen Israyl kumpipa Shaul i a nasempa David hi a, kei tawh a teng khawm hi a, kei kiangah hong tai-a kipan ama sungah khialhna ka mu kei hi,” a ci hi.

Ahih hangin Achish tungah Philistia makaipite heh uh ahih manin Philistia makaipite in ama kiangah, “Ama aa dingin na sehsaksa mun ah a ciahkik nadingin hih mipa thu pia in. Ei tawh gal kuan khawmsak kei in, tua bang hi kei leh gal sungah ei hong langpang kha ding hi. A ukpa maipha a ngah nadingin i mite’ lutang a lak ding sangin a hoihzaw bang om ding ahi hiam?
Amaute in a lam kawmun, ‘Shaul in a tultul that, David in a tul sawmsawm that,’ ci-in la a sak uh David hilo ahi hiam?” a ci uh hi.

Tua ciangin Achish in David samin, ama kiangah, “Yahweh a nungta ahih mah bangin na thutang a, ka galkap sungah kei tawh nong sepkhop ding ka lungkim mahmah hi. Kei kiangah nong tuna kipanin tuni dong na khialhna ka mu kei hi. Ahih hangin gam-ukte in nang hong deih lo uh hi.
